title: Co--dsorption of terrylene and tetrapentacontane on hexagonal boron nitride - towards a two-dimensional Shpolskii matrix
abstract: Organic molecular emitters are promising building blocks for quantum technologies, but their use at two-dimensional interfaces is limited by diffusion, aggregation, and photobleaching. We present work towards constructing an ultrathin two-dimensional Shpolskii-like host-guest matrix on hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) by co-depositing terrylene fluorophores with the long-chain tetrapentacontane in a solution-phase process. We demonstrate that this approach disperses terrylene in a roughly one-nanometer-thin alkane layer without detectable phase separation and allows tuning the emitter density from ensembles to isolated emitters showing characteristic blinking behavior consistent with single-molecule fluorescence. Time-lapse confocal microscopy, autocorrelation analysis, and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching show that suppressed diffusion and stable emitter positions can be achieved in several samples with a tetrapentacontane matrix. Encapsulation with hBN from the top side further improves photostability, with emitters demonstrating long lifetimes despite high photon doses. Successful co-adsorption of isolated emitters and alkane matrix is a milestone towards extending Shpolskii-type molecular isolation to hBN and provides a route towards stable, interface-integrated molecular qubits.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)

summaries.en: Co-depositing terrylene with the long-chain alkane tetrapentacontane on hexagonal boron nitride forms a roughly one-nanometer-thin two-dimensional Shpolskii-like host-guest matrix that disperses the emitters without detectable phase separation, suppresses diffusion, and, when capped with hBN, yields photostable isolated emitters at high photon doses.
summaries.zh: 将terrylene与长链烷烃tetrapentacontane共沉积在六方氮化硼上，可形成约一纳米厚的二维类Shpolskii主客体基质，使发光体均匀分散且无可检测的相分离、抑制扩散，并在顶部用hBN封装后于高光子剂量下获得光稳定的孤立发光体。
summaries.ja: テリレンと長鎖アルカンであるテトラペンタコンタンを六方晶窒化ホウ素上に共蒸着すると、約1ナノメートル厚の二次元Shpolskii様ホスト–ゲストマトリクスが形成され、検出可能な相分離なしに発光体が分散して拡散が抑制され、hBNで上部を封入することで高い光子線量下でも光安定な孤立発光体が得られる。

title: Thermal Stability and Structural Relaxation Kinetics of Commercially Pure Titanium
abstract: This work explores the structural relaxation of cryorolled commercially pure titanium subjected to subsequent this http URL specimens with an average grain size of ~50 nm were produced by plastic deformation via cryogenic rolling at 100 K to a true strain of 1.20, followed by annealing at 425 K, 525 K, 725 K, and 945 K. Microstructural evolution was examined using electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction. Cryogenic rolling was found to induce pronounced grain fragmentation, with coherent scattering regions (CSRs) of 30-50 nm dominating the substructure. X-ray diffraction analysis revealed that annealing drives crystallite growth: a slight increase at 525 K, accelerated coarsening at 725 K, and complete recrystallization at 945 K. The kinetics of grain growth follow the classical Lifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner model, with a growth exponent of ~4, reflecting the role of triple junctions and defect-controlled boundary diffusion. The activation energy, estimated at ~97 kJ/mol, corresponds to typical values for grain boundary diffusion in {\alpha}-Ti, confirming that cryogenic deformation produces a highly non-equilibrium microstructure whose relaxation is strongly temperature dependent.

summaries.en: Cryorolled commercially pure titanium with nanoscale coherent scattering regions shows temperature-dependent grain growth following Lifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner kinetics with a growth exponent of ~4 and an activation energy of ~97 kJ/mol consistent with grain boundary diffusion in alpha-Ti.
summaries.zh: 经低温轧制的商业纯钛具有纳米级相干散射区，其晶粒长大随温度变化并遵循Lifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner动力学，生长指数约为4，激活能约为97 kJ/mol，与α-Ti中的晶界扩散相符。
summaries.ja: 極低温圧延された商用純チタンはナノスケールのコヒーレント散乱領域を持ち、その粒成長は温度依存性を示してLifshitz-Slyozov-Wagner動力学に従い、成長指数は約4、活性化エネルギーは約97 kJ/molでα-Tiの粒界拡散と一致する。

title: Spectral properties of orthorhombic KSbOSiO$_4$ crystals: studies of infrared, visible and ultraviolet radiation absorption, Raman scattering, cathodoluminescence and photoluminescence
abstract: Crystals of orthorhombic KSbOSiO$_4$ (KSS) are often found to synthesize in glass of historical and artistic articles. For instance, these crystallites in the glass of turquoise Bohemian seed beads are known to play a significant role in the process of internal-stress driven corrosion of the glass causing deterioration and destruction of bead embroidered museum exhibits, especially articles made in the early 19th century. In art materials science, KSS has been known since the mid-2010s only for its destructive effects on historical glass objects, but as an optical material it has long been studied. KSS belongs to the group of compounds isomorphic to KTiOPO$_4$ (KTP) and, like other compounds from this group, has anomalies in dielectric constant. The article presents the results of a study of orthorhombic KSS crystals using a number of spectroscopic techniques. IR absorption and diffuse reflection spectra of KSS in the spectral range from 50 to 4000~cm$^{-1}$, its Raman spectrum, its absorption spectrum in the range from near infrared to ultraviolet as well as its cathodoluminescence and photoluminescence spectra are investigated. The constituent peaks of the spectral bands are analyzed and their properties are summarized in tables; the allowed direct and indirect band gaps of KSS are determined. The presented data are necessary both for the correct spectral analysis of historical and artistic glass and enamels, during the production of which this substance was sometimes synthesized in glass, and for a more in-depth study of crystals of the KTP group.

summaries.en: The study reports infrared absorption and diffuse reflection, Raman scattering, near-infrared-to-ultraviolet absorption, and cathodoluminescence and photoluminescence spectra of orthorhombic KSbOSiO4 crystals, identifying spectral band components and determining the allowed direct and indirect band gaps for use in analyzing historical glass and enamels and in further research on KTP-group crystals.
summaries.zh: 该研究报告了正交晶系KSbOSiO4晶体的红外吸收与漫反射、拉曼散射、近红外到紫外吸收以及阴极发光和光致发光光谱，分析了各谱带的组成峰并确定了允许的直接和间接带隙，这些数据既可用于历史艺术玻璃和珐琅的正确光谱分析，也有助于深入研究KTP族晶体。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、直方晶系KSbOSiO4結晶の赤外吸収・拡散反射、ラマン散乱、近赤外から紫外までの吸収、陰極発光および光ルミネセンスの各スペクトルを測定し、スペクトル帯の構成ピークを解析するとともに許容直接・間接バンドギャップを決定したもので、歴史的・芸術的ガラスやエナメルの分光分析およびKTP族結晶のより深い研究に資するデータを提供する。

title: Cavity-engineered ferroelectricity in SrTiO$_3$
abstract: Interfacing quantum materials with photonic cavity architectures is at the vanguard of materials engineering. The structured electromagnetic fluctuations of a dark cavity environment can renormalize fundamental thermodynamical material properties and energy scales, holding promise to create a rich ecosystem of cavity-induced ground states and functionalities absent in the bare material. However, direct experimental demonstrations that cavity coupling can stabilize or enhance genuinely new phases of matter have remained scarce. In this work, we establish the presence of cavity-induced and cavity-enhanced ferroelectric phases in free-standing SrTiO$_3$ membranes coupled to dark THz-frequency photonic crystal cavities. Using THz spectroscopy, we observe ultrastrong coupling (USC) between the ferroelectric soft mode in SrTiO$_3$ and the cavity resonance. The structural response of SrTiO$_3$ to this USC is measured via second harmonic generation imaging, which reveals a substantial (greater than 400%) enhancement of signal in the cavity environment and a distinct modification of the crystalline symmetry, indicating the onset and enhancement of ferroelectricity. We interpret these observations as resulting from renormalized piezoelectric and flexoelectric couplings, which in turn arise from the cavity-modified dielectric environment. This interpretation is supported with microscopic modeling via DFT-based multi-scale dynamics simulations and by macroscopic Ginzburg-Landau theory. Altogether, our experimental and theoretical results firmly confirm that cavity engineering can indeed be used to create new ground states in materials and enhance existing ones. This work establishes a new paradigm for materials engineering with direct applications for quantum transduction, quantum sensing, and nonlinear integrated photonics.

summaries.en: Coupling free-standing SrTiO3 membranes to dark THz photonic-crystal cavities produces ultrastrong coupling of the ferroelectric soft mode, which second-harmonic-generation imaging shows enhances the nonlinear signal by over 400% and modifies the crystal symmetry, indicating cavity-induced and cavity-enhanced ferroelectricity explained by renormalized piezoelectric and flexoelectric couplings supported by DFT-based multiscale simulations and Ginzburg-Landau theory.
summaries.zh: 将自由悬浮的SrTiO3薄膜与暗态太赫兹光子晶体腔耦合可实现铁电软模的超强耦合，二次谐波成像显示非线性信号增强超过400%且晶体对称性发生改变，表明腔内诱导并增强的铁电性，这一现象可由腔修饰的介电环境所重整的压电与挠曲电耦合解释，并得到基于DFT的多尺度动力学模拟和Ginzburg-Landau理论的支持。
summaries.ja: 自立SrTiO3膜を暗黒THzフォトニック結晶共振器に結合すると強誘電ソフトモードの超強結合が生じ、第二高調波発生イメージングにより400%を超える信号増強と結晶対称性の変化が観測され、これはキャビティ改変された誘電環境に由来する圧電・フレキソ電気結合の繰り込みとして解釈され、DFTに基づくマルチスケール動力学シミュレーションとGinzburg-Landau理論によって支持されるキャビティ誘起およびキャビティ増強強誘電性の存在を示す。

title: Gapless and Non-Equilibrium Topology in Blockaded Ladders
abstract: We propose a multi-leg PXYP model as a minimal setting to explore constraint-induced intertwinement between itinerant and internal degrees of freedom. We argue that the Rydberg-like blockade induces correlations in squeezed space, providing a unified mechanism for nontrivial string order both in and out of equilibrium. In a two-leg geometry, this leads to an intrinsically gapless topological ground state, which can terminate at a supersymmetric multicritical point. This mechanism also leads to the preservation of string order for parametrically long times after a quench, which we verify using tensor network simulations and a classical stochastic approximation to the dynamics. In a three-leg geometry, the blockade leads to an additional emergent $U(1)$ symmetry, resulting in a multicomponent Luttinger liquid where both itinerant and internal degrees of freedom are critical. This family of models arises naturally in a range of quantum simulator platforms such as Rydberg tweezer arrays and dipolar atoms in optical lattices.
subjects: Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The authors introduce a multi-leg PXYP model showing that Rydberg-like blockade induces correlations in squeezed space, yielding an intrinsically gapless topological ground state in a two-leg ladder that can terminate at a supersymmetric multicritical point and preserves string order for parametrically long times after a quench, while a three-leg geometry produces an emergent U(1) symmetry and a multicomponent Luttinger liquid.
summaries.zh: 作者提出了一个多腿PXYP模型，表明类里德堡阻塞在压缩空间中诱导出关联，在两腿梯形几何中产生内禀无能隙拓扑基态（可终止于超对称多临界点）并在淬火后参数化长时间内保持弦序，而三腿几何则导致涌现的U(1)对称性和多分量Luttinger液体。
summaries.ja: 著者らは多脚PXYP模型を提案し、リュードベリ的なブロッケードが圧縮空間における相関を誘起することで、二脚梯子では内在的にギャップレスなトポロジカル基底状態（超対称多重臨界点で終結し得る）とクエンチ後パラメトリックに長い時間保持されるストリング秩序が生じ、三脚幾何では創発的U(1)対称性と多成分Luttinger液体が得られることを示した。

title: Anisotropic spin splitting in $α$-MnTe epilayers on InP(111)A and Si(111) substrates
abstract: $\alpha$-MnTe has emerged as a prototypical altermagnetic material, combining compensated antiferromagnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting. Here, we investigate the structural and electronic properties of epitaxial $\alpha$-MnTe layers grown by molecular beam epitaxy on InP(111)A and Si(111) substrates. The crystalline and surface quality of the epilayers was characterised by reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and X-ray diffraction (XRD), confirming the formation of high-quality, single-phase films. The transport measurements were performed, confirming an antiferromagnetic transition and weak ferromagnetism. The electronic structure was studied using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). At 90 K, both samples exhibit relativistic anisotropic valence band splitting, which is substantially larger along the $\Gamma$-K direction, reaching approximately 300 meV, than along $\Gamma$-M, where values of about 150~meV are observed. The magnitude and momentum dependence of the splitting are very similar for $\alpha$-MnTe grown on the two different substrates, indicating the robustness of the altermagnetic electronic structure with respect to the epitaxial environment.

summaries.en: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy at 90 K reveals relativistic anisotropic valence-band spin splitting in epitaxial α-MnTe films on InP(111)A and Si(111) substrates, reaching about 300 meV along Γ-K versus about 150 meV along Γ-M, with nearly identical magnitude and momentum dependence on both substrates.
summaries.zh: 在90 K下进行的角分辨光电子能谱测量表明，生长于InP(111)A和Si(111)衬底上的外延α-MnTe薄膜存在相对论性各向异性价带自旋劈裂，沿Γ-K方向约为300 meV，明显大于沿Γ-M方向的约150 meV，且两种衬底上的劈裂大小与动量依赖关系几乎相同。
summaries.ja: 90 Kでの角度分解光電子分光により、InP(111)AおよびSi(111)基板上にエピタキシャル成長したα-MnTe薄膜は、Γ-K方向で約300 meV、Γ-M方向で約150 meVに達する相対論的な異方的価電子帯スピン分裂を示し、その大きさと運動量依存性は両基板でほぼ同一であることが明らかになった。

title: Quantum Monte-Carlo study of spin-valley ferromagnetism in rhombohedral graphene
abstract: Recent capacitance measurements in bilayer and trilayer rhombohedral graphene reported large magnetic entropy above the Curie temperature, suggesting the formation of fluctuating local moments. Further experimental support comes from scanning tunneling microscopy experiments in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene, which directly visualized honeycomb electron-crystal order that strengthens upon heating before melting, related to the Pomeranchuk effect. Motivated by these experiments, we construct spin-valley local-moment Hamiltonians for the quarter-metal and half-metal phases. We extract their couplings from constrained Hartree-Fock calculations, and solve their finite-temperature thermodynamics with stochastic-series-expansion quantum Monte Carlo. For the quarter metal we find a continuous 2D-Ising transition at $T_c \approx 0.7$ K, an order of magnitude smaller than the Hartree-Fock estimate (~30 K) and closer to the experimental scale of a few kelvin. For the half metal, we study the field-induced magnetization as a function of temperature with and without proximity-enhanced spin-orbit coupling. When spin-orbit coupling is negligible, intervalley Hund's coupling enhances the magnetic response. Strong spin-orbit coupling, as can be induced by a neighboring transition-metal dichalcogenide, gives rise to the standard spin-canted ground state at zero temperature. Upon heating, the in-plane polarization decreases more rapidly than the out-of-plane polarization. Surprisingly, despite the itinerant nature of the electrons, local-moment models with microscopically determined couplings appear to capture key finite-temperature magnetic properties of rhombohedral graphene without any fitting.

summaries.en: Using quantum Monte Carlo on microscopically determined spin-valley local-moment Hamiltonians, the authors find a 2D-Ising transition near 0.
summaries.zh: 作者对微观确定的自旋-谷局域矩哈密顿量进行量子蒙特卡洛计算，发现四分之一金属在约0.
summaries.ja: 著者らは微視的に決定したスピン・バレー局所モーメントのハミルトニアンに量子モンテカルロ法を適用し、クォーターメタルでは約0.

title: Subsonic terahertz plasmon instability in space-time plasmonic crystals
abstract: We investigate collective plasma-wave dynamics in a two-dimensional electron fluid subected to a travelling periodic modulation of the effective plasma velocity. Using a hydrodynamic description combined with Floquet-Bloch theory, we show that the travelling modulation acts as a moving plasmonic crystal whose band structure is governed by an effective drift velocity in the comoving frame. We demonstrate that the closure of the Bragg gap at the edge of the Brillouin zone gives rise to an exceptional point and triggers a Krein-type instability through the coupling of positive- and negative-energy modes. Analytical expressions are derived for the instability threshold and growth rate, revealing that self-amplification can occur even when the electron drift remains subsonic in the laboratory frame. Numerical simulations of the nonlinear hydrodynamic equations confirm the theoretical predictions and show the evolution towards a saturated regime dominated by a coherent Floquet-Bloch mode. These results identify travelling plasmonic crystals as a novel platform for wave amplification and non-Hermitian band dynamics in electronic fluids.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Other Condensed Matter (cond-mat.other); Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Plasma Physics (physics.plasm-ph)

summaries.en: This paper shows that a travelling periodic modulation of the effective plasma velocity in a two-dimensional electron fluid forms a moving plasmonic crystal whose Bragg-gap closure produces an exceptional point and a Krein-type instability, enabling plasmon self-amplification even for subsonic electron drift in the laboratory frame, as confirmed by nonlinear hydrodynamic simulations that saturate into a coherent Floquet-Bloch mode.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，二维电子液体中有效等离子体速度的行波周期调制会形成移动的等离激元晶体，其布拉格带隙闭合产生例外点并引发Krein型不稳定性，从而即使在实验室参考系中电子漂移为亚声速时也能实现等离激元自放大，非线性流体动力学模拟证实了这一点并显示系统最终饱和为相干Floquet-Bloch模式。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、二次元電子流体における有効プラズマ速度の進行波型周期変調が移動するプラズモニック結晶を形成し、そのブラッグギャップの閉合が例外点を生じてKrein型不安定性を引き起こすことで、実験室系で電子ドリフトが亜音速であってもプラズモンの自己増幅が可能となることを示し、非線形流体力学シミュレーションがこれを裏付けてコヒーレントなFloquet-Blochモードへ飽和することを明らかにした。

title: Tunable Three-Body Interactions in Microwave-Shielded Polar Molecules
abstract: We show that microwave shielding, which enables collisionally stable ultracold polar molecules, also leads to genuine nonadditive three-body interactions comparable to the shielding interaction itself. Their magnitude, sign, and geometrical dependence can be flexibly controlled through microwave parameters and orientation. Interaction strengths can reach the ten kilohertz-scale for ultrapolar molecules in typical optical lattices. The nonadditive three-body interactions can stabilize novel many-body phases, and should be accounted for in quantum simulation with microwave shielded molecules.
subjects: Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas) ; Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph); Chemical Physics (physics.chem-ph); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: Microwave shielding, which makes ultracold polar molecules collisionally stable, also produces genuine nonadditive three-body interactions that are comparable in strength to the shielding interaction and whose magnitude, sign, and geometry can be tuned via microwave parameters and orientation, reaching the ten-kilohertz scale for ultrapolar molecules in typical optical lattices and potentially stabilizing novel many-body phases that must be accounted for in quantum simulation.
summaries.zh: 微波屏蔽在使超冷极性分子具有碰撞稳定性的同时，也会产生与屏蔽相互作用强度相当的真实非可加三体相互作用，其大小、符号和几何依赖可通过微波参数和取向灵活调控，在典型光晶格中对超极性分子可达十千赫兹量级，并能稳定新奇的量子多体相，因此在用微波屏蔽分子的量子模拟中必须加以考虑。
summaries.ja: マイクロ波シールディングは超低温極性分子を衝突に対して安定化させる一方で、シールディング相互作用と同程度の真の非加算的三体相互作用を生み出し、その大きさ・符号・幾何学的依存性はマイクロ波パラメータと配向によって柔軟に制御でき、典型的な光格子中の超極性分子では十キロヘルツ規模に達して新規な多体相を安定化し得るため、マイクロ波シールディング分子を用いた量子シミュレーションでは考慮されるべきである。

title: The spin-transfer inverse Faraday effect in Au/YIG thin film bilayers
abstract: The inverse Faraday effect (IFE) (the generation of an effective magnetic field in a material upon irradiation with circularly polarized light) offers a pathway to ultrafast, non-thermal control of spin dynamics. In metallic/ferromagnetic-insulator (NM/FMI) bilayers, IFE-driven spin polarization in the metallic layer can be an alternative to generate magnon excitations in the magnetic insulator which otherwise would be inaccessible with photon energies below the insulator bandgap, but this avenue has remained mostly unexplored. In this work, we investigate the regime of spin-transfer via IFE in Au/YIG bilayers, by means of ultrafast time-resolved magneto-optical experiments. Understanding the mechanism of this spin-transfer IFE in these NM/FMI heterostructures is crucial for several reasons: it elucidates the fundamental coupling between light's angular momentum and collective spin modes at buried interfaces, it enables all-optical generation and manipulation of pure spin currents, and it paves the way toward THz-frequency spintronic devices leveraging the insulator's long magnon lifetimes.

summaries.en: This study uses ultrafast time-resolved magneto-optical experiments to investigate the spin-transfer inverse Faraday effect in Au/YIG bilayers, where circularly polarized light generates an effective magnetic field in the Au layer that can excite magnons in the YIG insulator despite photon energies below its bandgap.
summaries.zh: 本研究利用超快时间分辨磁光实验研究了Au/YIG双层中的自旋转移逆法拉第效应，其中圆偏振光在Au层中产生有效磁场，从而在光子能量低于YIG带隙的情况下激发YIG绝缘体中的磁振子。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、超高速時間分解磁気光学実験を用いてAu/YIG二層膜におけるスピン移動逆ファラデー効果を調べたもので、円偏光がAu層に有効磁場を生じ、YIGのバンドギャップより低い光子エネルギーでもYIG絶縁体中のマグノンを励起できることを示す。

title: Quantum-Geometric Subgap Second-Harmonic Generation in PT-Symmetric Antiferromagnetic Insulators
abstract: Although quantum geometry plays an established role in electronic transport and optical responses, the contribution of the time-reversal-odd Riemannian connection to fully subgap responses remains less explored. Here we identify intrinsic second-harmonic generation in PT-symmetric antiferromagnets, predominantly governed by the real sector of the interband Hermitian connection and arising entirely from virtual interband transitions. In bilayer MnBi$_2$Te$_4$, the response persists in trivial phases but is enhanced in the layer-Chern phase and reverses sign with Néel order, offering a probe of quantum geometry and phase-sensitive readout of antiferromagnetic order without mobile carriers or real excitations.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)

summaries.en: This paper identifies intrinsic subgap second-harmonic generation in PT-symmetric antiferromagnetic insulators, predominantly governed by the real sector of the interband Hermitian connection and arising entirely from virtual interband transitions, and shows in bilayer MnBi2Te4 that the response persists in trivial phases, is enhanced in the layer-Chern phase, and reverses sign with Néel order.
summaries.zh: 本文在PT对称反铁磁绝缘体中发现由能带间厄米联络实部主导、完全源于虚能带间跃迁的 intrinsic 亚带隙二次谐波产生，并表明在双层MnBi2Te4中该响应在平庸相中持续存在、在层陈数相中增强且随Néel序反号。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、PT対称な反磁性絶縁体において、バンド間エルミート接続の実部が主に支配し完全に仮想的なバンド間遷移に由来する内在的サブギャップ第二高調波発生を同定し、二層MnBi2Te4においてこの応答が自明相でも持続し、層チャーン相で増強され、ネール秩序に伴い符号を反転することを示した。

title: Quantifying Blinking Suppression and Probing Its Mechanism in PPD-Treated Single Quantum Dots
abstract: Colloidal semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are highly promising materials for various applications, yet photoluminescence intermittency (blinking) remains a key obstacle to their practical use. While recent advances have enabled partial or complete suppression of this effect, both the degree of suppression and the mechanism by which it occurs are often difficult to establish. In the present work we analyse the blinking suppression of single CdSe/ZnS QDs after treatment with p-phenylenediamine (PPD), recently discovered by Yang et al. We revisit the blinking mechanism in this system and show that it is governed predominantly by the trapping mechanism, rather than by Auger ionization as previously proposed. For data analysis we apply a threshold-free two-dimensional criterion recently proposed by Podshivaylov and Frantsuzov. The criterion is based on the relative quantum yield estimator $\langle \hat{Q} \rangle^{(s)}$ and the decay-rate fluctuation parameter $\hat{\xi}$. We found that PPD treatment significantly increases the relative quantum yield and leads to only a modest increase in $\hat{\xi}$, indicating that the dominant effect of PPD is to shift the distribution of the non-radiative recombination rate toward lower values, rather than to eliminate its fluctuations. We further suggest a number of possible mechanisms of PPD-induced suppression and propose critical experiments for their verification.
subjects: Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: Using a threshold-free two-dimensional analysis based on the relative quantum yield estimator and the decay-rate fluctuation parameter, this study shows that PPD treatment of single CdSe/ZnS quantum dots suppresses blinking predominantly by shifting the non-radiative recombination rate distribution toward lower values within a trapping mechanism, rather than eliminating rate fluctuations or acting via Auger ionization.
summaries.zh: 本研究采用基于相对量子产率估计量和衰减率涨落参数的无阈值二维分析，表明PPD处理单颗CdSe/ZnS量子点主要通过将非辐射复合速率分布移向较低值来抑制闪烁，其机制以陷阱机制为主，而非消除速率涨落或通过俄歇电离实现。
summaries.ja: 相対量子収率推定値と減衰率揺らぎパラメータに基づく閾値不要の二次元解析により、本研究は、単一CdSe/ZnS量子ドットへのPPD処理が非放射再結合速度の分布を低い値へ移行させることによって主にブリンキングを抑制し、その機構は速度揺らぎの消去やオージェイオン化ではなくトラッピング機構に支配されることを示した。

title: Dipolar Exciton Polarons in a van der Waals Homobilayer
abstract: Fermi polarons exemplify how many-body interactions give rise to emergent quasiparticles, providing a fundamental framework for understanding interacting quantum matter. In electron-doped two-dimensional semiconductors, exciton polarons offer optical access to Fermi-polaron physics and electrical tunability, yet achieving stronger and more controllable exciton-electron interactions remains a key challenge. Here, we realize dipolar exciton polarons in an electrically tunable van der Waals homobilayer, where interlayer excitons with spatially separated electrons and holes act as quantum impurities carrying permanent electric dipole moments. These dipolar polarons exhibit substantially enhanced exciton-electron interactions, with binding energies more than four times those of conventional intralayer exciton polarons. We further demonstrate that Fermi-sea layer polarization provides an additional degree of freedom for controlling many-body interactions. In particular, the presence of a Fermi sea induces hybridization between oppositely oriented dipolar polarons, whereas confining the Fermi sea to a single layer suppresses this hybridization and produces orientation-selective many-body dressing. Our findings establish an experimental platform for dipolar-polaron physics in which dipole orientation and Fermi-sea layer polarization jointly govern many-body interactions, opening a route towards electrically tunable interactions and dipolar-polaron-mediated attraction between itinerant electrons.

summaries.en: The paper realizes dipolar exciton polarons in an electrically tunable van der Waals homobilayer using interlayer excitons with permanent electric dipole moments, achieving exciton-electron binding energies over four times those of conventional intralayer polarons and showing that Fermi-sea layer polarization provides an additional degree of freedom that controls hybridization between oppositely oriented polarons and enables orientation-selective many-body dressing.
summaries.zh: 该论文在可电调控的范德华同质双层中实现了偶极激子极化子，利用具有永久电偶极矩的层间激子，获得了超过传统层内激子极化子四倍的激子-电子结合能，并证明费米海层极化提供了额外的自由度，可控制相反取向极化子之间的杂化并实现取向选择性的多体修饰。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、永久電気双極子モーメントを持つ層間励起子を用いて電気的に制御可能なファンデルワールス・ホモ二層中に双極子励起子ポーラロンを実現し、従来の層内励起子ポーラロンの4倍以上に及ぶ励起子-電子結合エネルギーを得るとともに、フェルミ海の層分極が反対向きのポーラロン間の混成を制御し配向選択的な多体ドレッシングを可能にする追加の自由度を提供することを示した。

title: Fano Resonance of a Magnonic Ring Resonator with a Nano-Scatterer Embedded in a Magnonic Conduit
abstract: We present micromagnetic simulation of a nanoscale magnonic ring resonator coupled to a magnonic waveguide, with and without a hole embedded in the waveguide (H-NRR and NRR respectively), for realizing transformation into a Fano resonance frequency spectral lineshape from a Lorentzian one. Transmission and reflection spectra of the H-NRR and NRR have been analyzed for different structural parameters (embedded hole diameter and gap between the ring and the waveguide) and material parameters (damping factor of the ring) to achieve maximum spectral transmission magnitude variation. The obtained micromagnetic simulation results are supported by an analytical model that consists of two-tracks of wave propagation, forwards and backwards. Our findings show that H-NRR system demonstrates a monotonic dependence of spectral transmission magnitude variation against the aforementioned design parameters (gap and damping) which should provide better engineering controllability and tolerance when compared with the original NRR system. Overall, our proposed structure and study may help in building unconventional magnonic integrated circuits for sensing, data processing systems and computing.

summaries.en: Micromagnetic simulations show that embedding a nanoscale hole in a magnonic waveguide coupled to a ring resonator produces a Fano resonance lineshape and gives monotonic, more controllable dependence of transmission variation on gap and damping than the hole-free design, supported by a two-track analytical model.
summaries.zh: 微磁模拟表明，在与环形谐振器耦合的磁振波导中嵌入纳米孔可将洛伦兹线型转变为Fano共振线型，并使透射幅度变化随间隙和阻尼单调变化、比无孔结构更易控制，且得到双路径解析模型的支持。
summaries.ja: マイクロマグネティックシミュレーションにより、リング共振器と結合したマグノニック導波路にナノスケールの穴を埋め込むとローレンツ型からファノ共鳴型へスペクトル線形が変換され、透過振幅変化がギャップとダンピングに対して単調依存して穴なし構造より制御性が高まることが、二経路解析モデルに支持されて示された。

title: Metadevices that compute: mathematical foundations and experimental implementations for neuromorphic nanophotonics
abstract: Wave-based analog computing has re-emerged as a compelling alternative to digital electronics for specific linear-algebraic and machine-learning workloads, promising massively parallel, high-bandwidth, and energy-efficient information processing. Metamaterials, metasurfaces, and integrated metastructures (collectively, metadevices) now perform mathematical operations, solve integral and differential equations, multiply matrices, and implement trainable photonic neural networks directly in the wave domain. This focused review consolidates the mathematical foundations that underpin such devices, i.e., the mapping between linear operators and wave scattering, the feedback architectures that realize equation inversion, and the inverse-design and scientific machine-learning toolchains that make their synthesis and training tractable, and connects them to the rapidly growing body of experimental demonstrations, from free-space diffractive processors to reconfigurable guided-wave metastructures. We conclude with open problems and opportunities for this emerging neuromorphic nanophotonics ecosystem.

summaries.en: This review consolidates the mathematical foundations—mapping linear operators to wave scattering, feedback architectures for equation inversion, and inverse-design and scientific machine-learning toolchains—alongside experimental demonstrations of metamaterials, metasurfaces, and integrated metastructures that perform analog optical computing and trainable photonic neural networks.
summaries.zh: 本综述整合了将线性算子映射到波散射、用于方程求逆的反馈架构以及逆设计与科学机器学习工具链等数学基础，并联系起从自由空间衍射处理器到可重构导波超构结构等日益增多的实验演示，这些超构材料、超构表面和集成超构器件可直接在波域执行模拟计算和可训练光子神经网络。
summaries.ja: 本レビューは、線形作用素と波散乱の対応付け、方程式逆算を実現するフィードバック構造、そして逆設計と科学機械学習のツールチェーンといった数学的基盤を整理するとともに、自由空間回折プロセッサから再構成可能な導波路メタ構造に至る実験的実証の急速な蓄積を結びつけ、メタマテリアル・メタサーフェス・集積メタ構造が波領域で直接アナログ演算や訓練可能なフォトニックニューラルネットワークを実行する様相を論じる。

title: Construction and Commissioning of a Compact Xenon Gas Recycling System for a High-Harmonic Generation VUV Frequency Comb
abstract: A compact, closed-loop xenon recycling system for application in a High-Harmonic Generation (HHG) Vacuum-UV (VUV) frequency comb laser systems is designed, constructed and commissioned. It consists of three main sections, a low-pressure section (LPS) pre-filtering the gas of particulates, water and hydrocarbons, then a compression station (CS), allowing for a variable pressure of up to 60 bar, and a high-pressure section (HPS) with more filtering, pressure control and monitoring. The system proves to meet all design criteria in gas quality (the sum off all hydrocarbon contaminations up to 120 amu and CO$_{2}$ being below 10$^{-8}$ mbar) and recovery efficiency (>99.8$\%$ for all expected operational cases, neglecting possible geometric gas catcher losses in the HHG laser itself). The operation and results are presented and discussed. Furthermore, the system is compared to the performance of a similar system from which it is derived.

summaries.en: A compact closed-loop xenon recycling system for high-harmonic-generation VUV frequency-comb lasers has been constructed and commissioned, achieving hydrocarbon and CO2 contamination below 10^-8 mbar and xenon recovery efficiency above 99.
summaries.zh: 本文设计、建造并调试了一套用于高次谐波产生真空紫外频率梳激光系统的紧凑型闭环氙气回收系统，其烃类和二氧化碳污染低于10^-8 mbar，在所有预期工况下氙气回收效率超过99.
summaries.ja: 高次高調波発生真空紫外周波数コムレーザー用のコンパクトな閉ループキセノン回収システムを設計・製作・試運転し、炭化水素およびCO2汚染が10^-8 mbar未満、想定される全運用条件でキセノン回収効率99.

title: Characteristics of VHF and UHF band detection using Stark shifting in Rydberg-atom sensors
abstract: We present a characterization of the sensitivity of broadband electric field measurements in the Very High Frequency (VHF) and Ultra High Frequency (UHF) bands using AC stark shifting of Rydberg states. The dependence of the sensitivity and dynamic range of the field measurements using nD5/2 states of cesium for principal quantum numbers n= 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100 is presented, detailing the intricacies involved. The frequencies considered for the measurement range from 50 MHz to 900 MHz for which a transverse electromagnetic (TEM) cell is used to excite the Rydberg atoms with the RF fields. The corresponding sensitivities achieved are in the $(\mu V/m)/\sqrt{Hz}$ range. A general trend of better sensitivity for higher principal quantum numbers is observed. This work paves the way for a better understanding of the AC Stark dependent field measurements using Rydberg sensors.

summaries.en: This study characterizes the sensitivity and dynamic range of broadband VHF and UHF electric-field measurements from 50 to 900 MHz using AC Stark shifting of cesium nD5/2 Rydberg states with principal quantum numbers n=60 to 100, achieving sensitivities in the (μV/m)/√Hz range and generally finding better sensitivity for higher principal quantum numbers.
summaries.zh: 本研究利用铯nD5/2里德伯态（主量子数n=60至100）的交流斯塔克频移，表征了50至900 MHz范围内宽带甚高频和特高频电场测量的灵敏度与动态范围，达到(μV/m)/√Hz量级的灵敏度，并总体观察到主量子数越高灵敏度越好的趋势。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、セシウムのnD5/2リュードベリ状態（主量子数n=60から100）のACシュタルクシフトを用いて、50～900 MHzの広帯域VHF・UHF電界測定の感度とダイナミックレンジを評価し、(μV/m)/√Hz程度の感度を達成するとともに、主量子数が高いほど感度が良くなる全般的な傾向を観測した。

title: Comparison of melanin subtypes using pump-probe microscopy
abstract: Pump-probe microscopy (PPM) is used to probe excited state dynamics of endogenous chromophores to generate contrast that is unavailable in traditional forms of microscopy. Here we apply PPM to characterize melanin, a pigment central to photoprotection, skin and eye pigmentation, and melanoma pathogenesis. Melanin is notoriously difficult to analyze due to its structural and chemical complexity. We imaged melanin from six different lesion categories: cutaneous nevi, lentigo, cutaneous malignant melanoma, conjunctival melanocytic lesions, vulvar melanocytic lesions, and a murine melanoma model, across 21 independent biological samples and 109 regions of interest. Using model fitting, adapted phasor analysis, and support vector machine classification, we characterize and quantify excited-state dynamics as a surrogate for chemical and structural heterogeneity. Heterogeneity of melanin separates cutaneous from non-cutaneous lesions, but is not correlated with malignancy. Benign lentigo is the most heterogeneous population in the dataset, exceeding cutaneous malignant melanoma, while conjunctival lesions are the most homogeneous despite receiving direct solar exposure. Classification on full transient absorption curves separates most subtypes well above the six-class chance level. These findings demonstrate the ability of PPM to reveal subtle differences in melanin photophysics across diverse tissue environments, with implications for optical tissue classification and the understanding of melanoma pathogenesis.

summaries.en: Pump-probe microscopy characterization of melanin excited-state dynamics across 21 biological samples and 109 regions of interest shows that melanin heterogeneity separates cutaneous from non-cutaneous lesions but is not correlated with malignancy, with benign lentigo being the most heterogeneous and conjunctival lesions the most homogeneous, and that classification of full transient absorption curves distinguishes most subtypes well above chance.
summaries.zh: 利用泵浦-探测显微镜对21个生物样本和109个感兴趣区域中黑色素激发态动力学的表征表明，黑色素异质性可将皮肤病变与非皮肤病变区分开，但与恶性程度不相关，良性雀斑样痣异质性最高、结膜病变异质性最低，并且基于完整瞬态吸收曲线的分类能以远高于随机水平的准确率区分大多数亚型。
summaries.ja: 21の生物学的サンプルと109の関心領域にわたるメラニンの励起状態ダイナミクスのポンプ・プローブ顕微鏡による解析は、メラニンの不均一性が皮膚病変と非皮膚病変を区別するものの悪性度とは相関せず、良性の黒子が最も不均一で結膜病変が最も均一であること、および完全な過渡吸収曲線に基づく分類が大多数のサブタイプを偶然水準を大きく上回って識別できることを示した。

title: Microscopic Theory of Spin-Orbit Interactions of Light
abstract: Optical spin-orbit interactions (SOI), demonstrated experimentally in optical cavities, enable the polarization degrees of freedom of light to be described and controlled as an effective pseudospin, providing a foundation for spintronic-like control of light and the development of next-generation optical technologies. However, prior works describe this emergent effect using phenomenological models that fail to uncover its microscopic quantum origins, and as a result, a rigorous connection between material electronic structure and the optical SOI remains elusive. In this work, we address this fundamental challenge by developing a microscopic quantum theory starting from the non-relativistic quantum electrodynamical (QED) description of light-matter interactions. We show that this effect arises from virtual interactions between confined photons and material excitations. Crucially, our theoretical framework provides microscopic material-design principles for tuning the distinct components of optical SOI, which include the optical birefringence, photonic self-energies, TE-TM splitting, and optical Zeeman splitting, enabling precise engineering of effective magnetic fields, diabolical points, and pseudospin textures. We anticipate that the predictive capability of our microscopic theory will enable systematic screening and design of material systems for photonic spintronics and optical technologies.

summaries.en: A microscopic quantum theory based on non-relativistic quantum electrodynamics shows that optical spin-orbit interactions arise from virtual interactions between confined photons and material excitations, providing material-design principles to tune optical birefringence, photonic self-energies, TE-TM splitting, and optical Zeeman splitting for engineering effective magnetic fields, diabolical points, and pseudospin textures.
summaries.zh: 基于非相对论量子电动力学的微观量子理论表明，光学自旋-轨道相互作用源于受限光子与材料激发之间的虚相互作用，并提供了调节光学双折射、光子自能、TE-TM劈裂和光学塞曼劈裂的材料设计原则，从而可精确设计有效磁场、狄亚波利点和赝自旋织构。
summaries.ja: 非相対論的量子電磁力学に基づく微視的量子理論により、光学的スピン軌道相互作用は閉じ込められた光子と物質励起の間の仮想的相互作用に由来することが示され、光学複屈折、フォトニック自己エネルギー、TE-TM分裂、光学ゼーマン分裂を調整して有効磁場、ディアボリカル点、擬スピンテクスチャを精密に設計するための材料設計指針が提供される。

title: From proof of concept to practice: the next decade of artificial intelligence in metasurface photonics
abstract: Over the past decade, artificial intelligence has learned to predict electromagnetic responses rapidly and generate high-performance metasurface designs. However, one question remains open: compared with conventional design workflows that contain no learned model, has it made the complete design workflow faster, and are the resulting devices better? We argue that the answer depends on the task. Reading 100 highly cited optical studies in depth, we distinguish the design tasks in which artificial intelligence is irreplaceable, clearly advantageous, or without clear advantage. In our view, the key to the next decade is not more successes in isolated tasks but making each success a foundation for the field, through shifts such as shared data, trained models, and physics written into learning. Whether artificial intelligence leaves lasting value in this field will depend on whether its benefits can be verified, its methods transferred, and its designs corrected by experiment.

summaries.en: By reviewing 100 highly cited optical studies, the authors argue that AI's value in metasurface photonics depends on the task, and that the field's next decade hinges on shared data, transferable models, physics-informed learning, and experimental verification rather than isolated successes.
summaries.zh: 通过深入研读100篇高被引光学研究，作者指出人工智能在超表面光子学中的价值取决于具体任务，而该领域未来十年的关键在于共享数据、可迁移模型、物理嵌入学习和实验验证，而非孤立任务的成果。
summaries.ja: 100件の高被引用光学研究を精読した上で、著者らはメタサーフェスフォトニクスにおける人工知能の価値はタスクに依存すると論じ、今後10年の鍵は孤立した成功ではなく、共有データ、転移可能なモデル、物理学を組み込んだ学習、実験による検証にあると主張する。

title: Atomistic Emergence of Vibrational Polariton Condensation
abstract: Nonequilibrium polariton condensation is a macroscopic quantum phenomenon in which overwhelming population accumulation is observed at the band edge of the lower polariton (LP) dispersion curve under incoherent material pumping. As a promising route toward nonequilibrium Bose--Einstein condensates, its description, however, remains predominantly limited to models with phenomenological material parameters. Herein, a fully atomistic description of vibrational polariton condensation is developed by employing mesoscale cavity molecular dynamics simulations, a method which self-consistently propagates classical electromagnetic dynamics coupled to realistic molecules in a multimode Fabry--Pérot cavity. Under continuous-wave pumping, a lower polariton condensate forms when the infrared cavity is coupled to harmonic, homogeneously broadened molecular vibrations, such as the bending modes of liquid CO2 and CS2, whereas anharmonic stretching modes and liquids with fast intramolecular relaxation hardly condense. The role of libration-bending coupling for facilitating the LP condensation is further discussed. GPU-accelerated mesoscale simulations involving approximately 50 million atoms additionally provide direct two-dimensional real-space imaging of fluid-like polariton patterns during the condensation formation. Overall, this study provides key design insights into vibrational polariton condensation as a novel approach for controlling liquid-phase chemistry.

summaries.en: Using GPU-accelerated mesoscale cavity molecular dynamics simulations of about 50 million atoms, this study provides a fully atomistic description showing that vibrational lower polariton condensation under continuous-wave pumping occurs for harmonic, homogeneously broadened molecular vibrations such as the bending modes of liquid CO2 and CS2 but hardly for anharmonic stretching modes or liquids with fast intramolecular relaxation, while also revealing the role of libration-bending coupling and enabling real-space imaging of fluid-like polariton patterns.
summaries.zh: 本研究采用GPU加速的约5000万原子介观腔分子动力学模拟，给出了振动极化激元凝聚的全原子描述，表明在连续波泵浦下，当红外腔与谐性、均匀展宽的分子振动（如液态CO2和CS2的弯曲模式）耦合时可形成下极化激元凝聚，而反对称伸缩模式及具有快速分子内弛豫的液体则难以凝聚，并进一步揭示了振动-弯曲耦合的作用以及凝聚形成过程中流体状极化激元图案的实空间成像。
summaries.ja: 本研究は約5000万原子を扱うGPU加速メソスケール共振器分子動力学シミュレーションにより、連続波励起下で調和的かつ均一に広がった分子振動（液体CO2やCS2の変角モードなど）が赤外共振器と結合すると下部ポラリトン凝縮が形成される一方、非調和伸縮モードや速い分子内緩和を持つ液体ではほとんど凝縮しないことを示し、振動-変角結合の役割や凝縮形成中の流体的ポラリトンパターンの実空間イメージングも明らかにした、振動ポラリトン凝縮の全原子的記述を提供する。

title: Intensity-Domain Demultiplexing of Orbital Angular Momentum Channels for Optical Communication
abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing has been limited in practice by the complexity and optical loss of the elements that separate the channels at the receiver side. Here we adopt the azimuthal harmonics of OAM petal patterns as the demultiplexing basis, which makes the receiver the optical counterpart of the circular antenna arrays used in radio OAM links: the petal pattern of topological charge $\ell$ carries a single azimuthal harmonic of order $2\ell$, so one Fourier transform of the azimuthal intensity profile returns every channel, without gratings or mode sorters. The petals are formed by projecting a vector vortex beam from a single q-plate onto a linear polarization. A two-channel system at 515 nm with a 16-position circular photoreceiver array reaches 5.2 Gb/s below the forward error correction threshold, 2.6 Gb/s per channel from a 1.4 GHz photoreceiver.

summaries.en: By exploiting the azimuthal harmonics of OAM petal patterns generated by projecting a vector vortex beam from a single q-plate onto a linear polarization, a Fourier transform of the azimuthal intensity profile demultiplexes all OAM channels without gratings or mode sorters, enabling a two-channel 515 nm link with a 16-position circular photoreceiver array to reach 5.
summaries.zh: 通过利用单个q板产生的矢量涡旋光束投影到线偏振上所形成的OAM花瓣图案的方位角谐波，对强度方位角分布做一次傅里叶变换即可无需光栅或模式分选器地解复用所有OAM信道，使采用16位圆形光电接收阵列的双信道515 nm系统在低于前向纠错阈值下达到5.
summaries.ja: 単一のq-plateからのベクトル渦光線を直線偏光に射影して形成したOAM花瓣パターンの方位角高調波を利用し、方位角強度プロファイルの1回のフーリエ変換でグレーティングやモードソーターなしに全OAMチャネルを分離でき、16素子円形光検出器アレイを用いた515 nmの2チャネル系で前方誤り訂正閾値以下で5.

title: Non-contact temperature sensing and optical scatter in cryogenically-cooled crystalline silicon
abstract: Cryogenic crystalline silicon is a promising optical material for next generation gravitational-wave detectors due to its low mechanical loss (a driver of thermal noise), high thermal conductivity and zero coefficient of thermal expansion at 123 K. In this paper, we report on the design and results of an experiment to measure the temperature of a flat-flat uncoated crystalline silicon sample using a non-contact sensing method relying on interference (optical fringes) made from reflections between the front and back surfaces. We also propose a scheme for implementation of this technique for cryogenic test masses in future gravitational-wave detectors such as Einstein Telescope and LIGO Voyager. Additionally, we characterize the optical scattering of the sample in vacuum at cryogenic temperatures by using a high-sensitivity infrared camera. We measured relatively constant scatter with an average bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) of $(4.43\pm0.2)\times 10^{-3}\,\mathrm{sr^{-1}}$ at a scattering angle of $\theta_{s} = 7.5^\circ$ over the (cold-plate) temperature range of 123-294 K and saw no evidence for growth of cryogenic molecular layers (ice) on the sample in our current setup.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates non-contact temperature sensing of an uncoated flat-flat crystalline silicon sample at cryogenic temperatures using optical fringes from front-to-back surface reflections, proposes implementation for future gravitational-wave detector test masses, and reports a roughly constant bidirectional reflectance distribution function of (4.
summaries.zh: 本文利用前后表面反射形成的干涉条纹，实现了对无镀膜平-平晶体硅样品的非接触式低温温度测量，提出了将该技术应用于未来引力波探测器测试质量的具体方案，并测得在123–294 K范围内、7.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、表裏面反射による干渉縞を利用した非接触温度計測により無コーティングの平-平結晶シリコン試料の極低温温度を測定し、将来の重力波検出器の試験質量への実装案を提示するとともに、123–294 Kの範囲で散乱角7.

title: Dual-rate optical frequency comb based on a cylindrical microresonator with a nanoscale radius variation
abstract: We theoretically find that a cylindrical microresonator with nanoscale radius variation can be a source of coherent microcombs with two repetition rates, independently controlled by the device geometry. This phenomenon arises from the formation of two-dimensional axial-azimuthal dissipative Kerr solitons (2D DKS), which we discovered through numerical simulations of the nonlinearly coupled Lugiato-Lefever equations with realistic microresonator device parameters. We demonstrate that, despite the variation in the dispersion characteristics of azimuthal modes at different axial numbers, the spontaneous synchronization mechanism leads to a unified soliton repetition rate. We consider near-parabolic variations in the radius of a cylindrical resonator, compatible with the surface nanoscale axial photonics (SNAP) platform. In our example, we generate 2D DKS with an azimuthal rate of approximately 329 GHz and an axial rate of 6 GHz, which can be adjusted on demand by selecting the appropriate resonator geometry, thereby promising compact sources of frequency combs operating simultaneously across different frequency scales.

summaries.en: Numerical simulations of nonlinearly coupled Lugiato-Lefever equations show that a cylindrical microresonator with nanoscale radius variation can generate two-dimensional axial-azimuthal dissipative Kerr solitons, producing coherent microcombs with two independently geometry-controlled repetition rates (e.
summaries.zh: 对非线性耦合Lugiato-Lefever方程的数值模拟表明，具有纳米级半径变化的圆柱形微谐振器可产生二维轴向-方位角耗散克尔孤子，从而生成具有两个可由器件几何结构独立控制的重复频率（例如约329 GHz的方位角频率和约6 GHz的轴向频率）的相干微梳，且尽管不同轴向阶数下方位角模式的色散特性存在差异，自发同步机制仍导致统一的孤子重复频率。
summaries.ja: 非線形結合Lugiato-Lefever方程式の数値シミュレーションにより、ナノスケールの半径変動を持つ円筒形マイクロ共振器が二次元の軸方向-方位角方向の散逸カーソリトンを生成し、デバイス形状で独立に制御できる二つの繰り返し周波数（例えば方位角方向約329 GHz、軸方向約6 GHz）を持つコヒーレントなマイクロコムを実現できること、また軸次数ごとの方位角モードの分散特性の違いにもかかわらず自発的同期機構が単一のソリトン繰り返し周波数をもたらすことを示した。

title: Streptavidin-Biotin Binding is Intrinsically Non-Cooperative, but Experimental Artefacts Can Induce Apparent Positive Cooperativity
abstract: The biotin-streptavidin interaction is a key component of nanobiotechnology, yet the nature of its cooperativity remains a debated question. Here, we introduce a label-free spectroscopy approach based on confocal UV autofluorescence microscopy to probe the binding cooperativity of this high-affinity system. By leveraging the intrinsic autofluorescence of tryptophan residues, we avoid artefacts associated with extrinsic fluorescent labels, enabling precise measurements of fully biotin-saturated streptavidin across a wide range of molar ratios. Our experimental results, supported by Monte Carlo simulations, provide conclusive evidence for the absence of cooperativity. However, we show that false signs of apparent positive cooperativity can emerge from local concentration inhomogeneities occurring when rapid reaction kinetics outpace mixing. By establishing the non-cooperative nature of biotin-streptavidin binding and identifying the key conditions to avoid cooperativity artefacts, these insights resolve a longstanding debate and offer critical implications for streptavidin-based biotechnological applications.

summaries.en: Label-free confocal UV autofluorescence microscopy and Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that streptavidin-biotin binding is intrinsically non-cooperative, with apparent positive cooperativity arising only from local concentration inhomogeneities when rapid kinetics outpace mixing.
summaries.zh: 无标记共聚焦紫外自发荧光显微镜和蒙特卡罗模拟表明，链霉亲和素-生物素结合本质上是非协同的，表观正协同性仅源于快速动力学超过混合速度时出现的局部浓度不均匀。
summaries.ja: ラベルフリー共焦点紫外自家蛍光顕微鏡とモンテカルロシミュレーションにより、ストレプトアビジン-ビオチン結合は本質的に非協同的であり、見かけの正の協同性は迅速な反応速度が混合を上回る際の局所的な濃度不均一にのみ起因することが示された。

title: Reconfigurable Generation of Terahertz Spiral Vector Beams Based on All-Dielectric Cascaded Metasurfaces
abstract: The reconfigurable generation of complex structured terahertz (THz) fields, and vector beams in particular, remains a significant challenge. Here, we propose a novel all-dielectric cascaded-metasurface scheme for the reconfigurable generation of THz spiral vector beams. By combining an isotropic phase-compensation layer with an anisotropic circular-polarization-sensitive layer, together with a new phase design tailored to spiral beams, we achieve independent control of the left- and right-handed circularly polarized (LCP and RCP) components through the relative rotation angle between the two layers. Under linearly polarized THz wave illumination, THz vector beams with switchable spiral numbers of 1-3 and reversible circular-polarization handedness are demonstrated at frequencies around 0.9 THz. Moreover, owing to the longitudinal evolution characteristic of spiral beams, the three generated THz vector beams exhibit azimuthal rotations of 279.9°, 125.7° and 75.5°, respectively, along the propagation direction. Such complex THz vector beams, which combine reconfigurability with longitudinal evolution, are expected to find applications in emerging fields such as next-generation wireless communications and THz imaging. The proposed generation scheme also offers a useful reference for the reconfigurable generation of high-dimensional vector beams.

summaries.en: An all-dielectric cascaded-metasurface scheme with an isotropic phase-compensation layer and an anisotropic circular-polarization-sensitive layer enables reconfigurable generation of terahertz spiral vector beams whose spiral numbers of 1–3 and circular-polarization handedness are switched via the relative rotation angle between the layers, while longitudinal evolution produces azimuthal rotations of 279.
summaries.zh: 该工作提出一种由各向同性相位补偿层与各向异性圆偏振敏感层构成的全介质级联超表面方案，通过两层间的相对旋转角独立调控左、右旋圆偏振分量，在约0.
summaries.ja: 各等方性位相補償層と異方性円偏光感受層からなる全誘電体カスケードメタサーフェスを用い、2層間の相対回転角によって左円偏光成分と右円偏光成分を独立に制御することで、約0.

title: Ultraviolet Raman spectroscopy using multimode aluminum oxide waveguides
abstract: Waveguide-based Raman spectroscopy offers a route toward compact and integrated photonic sensors. While most waveguide Raman platforms operate in the near-infrared, extending excitation toward the visible and ultraviolet is attractive because shorter excitation wavelengths can provide substantially stronger Raman scattering and access to resonance-enhanced molecular responses. This transition, however, places greater demands on the photonic material because of optical loss, absorption and waveguide-generated spectral background. Here, we investigate aluminum oxide ($Al_2O_3$) waveguides as a low-background platform for Raman spectroscopy at 532 nm and 325 nm using a back-collected excitation and detection geometry. At 532 nm, after normalization to the incident excitation power-time product, the measured $Al_2O_3$ background was more than two orders of magnitude lower than that of $Si_3N_4$. Under 325 nm excitation, the waveguides maintained a weak and reproducible spectral background across the investigated widths. Using immersion oil as a model analyte deposited over the waveguide surface, we demonstrate that analyte-specific Raman fingerprints can be recovered above the waveguide background at both wavelengths. Signal-to-background ratio and spectral contrast were used to quantify analyte visibility relative to the waveguide background, and both metrics consistently confirmed clear detection of the analyte bands. These results demonstrate that $Al_2O_3$ combines low measured spectral background with operation from the visible into the ultraviolet, providing a promising route toward integrated Raman spectroscopy at shorter excitation wavelengths.

summaries.en: Aluminum oxide waveguides enable low-background Raman spectroscopy at 532 nm and 325 nm, with background more than two orders of magnitude lower than Si3N4 at 532 nm and analyte fingerprints recoverable above the waveguide background at both wavelengths.
summaries.zh: 氧化铝波导可在532 nm和325 nm激发下实现低背景拉曼光谱，在532 nm处其背景比Si3N4低两个数量级以上，并能在两种波长下从波导背景中恢复出分析物的拉曼指纹。
summaries.ja: 酸化アルミニウム導波路は532 nmおよび325 nm励起で低バックグラウンドのラマン分光を可能にし、532 nmではバックグラウンドがSi3N4より2桁以上低く、両波長で導波路バックグラウンド上に分析物のラマンフィンガープリントを取得できる。

title: Roadmap: Image reconstruction in emission tomography for the era of fast Monte Carlo simulation
abstract: Quantitative image reconstruction in positron emission tomography and single photon emission computed tomography depends on how accurately the forward model describes photon emission, transport and detection. Monte Carlo simulation is the most complete model available, yet it is mostly used as an offline reference rather than inside the reconstruction. This roadmap asks what it would take to change that. The main obstacle is not only simulation time. Iterative reconstruction requires the expectation of the measured data and the gradient of the data fidelity, whereas Monte Carlo simulation produces noisy realisations of a complete acquisition. GPU implementations, variance reduction and learned surrogate models have made simulations much faster. At the same time, modern scanners acquire ever larger data sets with larger system models, and further gains in quantitative accuracy require more detailed physics. We discuss how fast Monte Carlo simulation can improve the modelling of the system response, scatter, positron range and the joint estimation of activity and attenuation, how noisy simulations can enter reconstruction algorithms, and which computing hardware makes this feasible. Monte Carlo simulation is most valuable where analytic models fail, and most practical solutions will combine both. The most immediate benefit of fast simulators is the validation and calibration of faster analytic models, together with more accurate, absolutely quantitative scatter estimates. Key open problems are the use of noisy simulations as expectations, in particular for sparse data, the computation of gradients and adjoints, the allocation of a limited simulation budget, and the use of scattered events as a source of information rather than a nuisance. Faster simulators are necessary but not sufficient, and progress requires simulators and reconstruction methods to be developed together.

summaries.en: This roadmap argues that fast Monte Carlo simulation should be integrated into emission tomography reconstruction, but since it yields noisy realizations rather than the expectations and gradients that iterative algorithms require, simulators and reconstruction methods must be developed together, with the most immediate benefits being validation and calibration of analytic models and more accurate absolute scatter estimates.
summaries.zh: 该路线图主张将快速蒙特卡洛模拟整合进发射断层重建，但由于模拟产生的是含噪实现而非迭代算法所需的期望与梯度，模拟器与重建方法必须协同发展，其最直接的收益是验证和校准解析模型以及获得更准确的绝对散射估计。
summaries.ja: 本ロードマップは、高速モンテカルロシミュレーションを放出断層断層撮影の再構成に統合すべきと主張するが、シミュレーションは反復アルゴリズムが必要とする期待値や勾配ではなく雑音を含む実現値を生み出すため、シミュレータと再構成法を共に開発する必要があり、最も直接的な利点は解析モデルの検証と校正、およびより正確な絶対散乱推定である。

title: Magnetic scattering experiments with an ultrashort pulsed soft X-ray source using iLGADs
abstract: Inverse Low Gain Avalanche Diode (iLGAD) sensors developed at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI) in collaboration with the Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) have demonstrated an excellent Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and Quantum Efficiency (QE) in the soft X-ray range. In the current batch, single-photon detection is achievable at 400 eV with an SNR > 5, while the QE surpasses 85 % at 250 eV. Combined with the high frame rates of CMOS readout ASIC, iLGAD sensors make the hybrid pixel detectors excellent candidates for time-resolved magnetic Small Angle X-ray Scattering (mSAXS) experiments in the soft X-ray energy range. In this contribution, we evaluated ILGAD sensors bump-bonded to 25 {\mu}m pitch charge-integrating MÖNCH chips at a laser-driven soft X-ray source. During the experiments, we measured energy-dispersed radiation between 600 eV and 1500 eV. These measurements were performed for the iLGAD sensor, as well as for the standard silicon sensor. Using the high-precision electronic trigger of the X-ray source, we were able to synchronise the detector with the X-ray source delivering few-picosecond pulses and optimise the timing parameters for the acquisition. Finally, we successfully performed the mSAXS experiment probing the magnetic domain pattern of a FeGd heterostructure, demonstrating better performance than a MÖNCH detector with a standard silicon sensor. ILGAD sensors achieved a significantly higher photon detection efficiency and, consequently, a higher sensitivity compared to standard silicon sensors under the same conditions, particularly for the lower-energy Fe L3 edge.

summaries.en: iLGAD sensors bump-bonded to MÖNCH chips achieved single-photon detection with high signal-to-noise ratio and quantum efficiency at soft X-ray energies, enabling synchronised time-resolved magnetic small-angle X-ray scattering of FeGd magnetic domains with greater sensitivity than standard silicon sensors.
summaries.zh: 与MÖNCH芯片倒装互连的iLGAD传感器在软X射线能量范围内实现了高信噪比和高量子效率的单光子探测，从而能够对FeGd磁畴进行同步时间分辨磁小角X射线散射测量，且灵敏度高于标准硅传感器。
summaries.ja: MÖNCHチップにバンプ接合したiLGADセンサーは軟X線領域で高い信号対雑音比と量子効率の単光子検出を実現し、FeGd磁区の同期時間分解磁気小角X線散乱測定を可能にし、標準シリコンセンサーより高い感度を示した。

title: Photonic Crystal Integrated Graphene-Silicon Schottky Diodes for Resonant Infrared Photodetection
abstract: Narrowband infrared (IR) photodetection has become a critical technology for the next generation of smart low-power photodetectors. In this work, we present a device based on a graphene-silicon Schottky junction with narrowband response in the short-wave IR (SWIR) regime. Integrating a photonic crystal (PhC) slab in the device enables a wavelength dependant tailoring of graphene absorption. The devices were characterized by photocurrent measurement, which was enhanced more than two orders of magnitude by the PhC integration. The sharp enhancements obtained can also be predicted by numerical simulation. This approach offers a highly scalable, tunable, CMOS-compatible architecture for narrowband IR photodetection, paving the way for next-generation, low-power IR sensors.

summaries.en: A graphene-silicon Schottky junction integrated with a photonic crystal slab achieves narrowband short-wave infrared photodetection with over two orders of magnitude photocurrent enhancement that matches numerical predictions, offering a scalable, tunable, CMOS-compatible platform for low-power IR sensors.
summaries.zh: 一种集成光子晶体平板的石墨烯-硅肖特基结实现了短波红外波段的窄带光电探测,其光电流增强超过两个数量级且与数值模拟预测相符,为低功耗红外传感器提供了可扩展、可调谐且CMOS兼容的平台。
summaries.ja: フォトニック結晶スラブを集積したグラフェン-シリコンショットキー接合により、短波長赤外域で狭帯域光検出を実現し、光電流は2桁以上増強されて数値シミュレーション予測とも一致し、スケーラブルで調整可能なCMOS互換の低消費電力赤外センサ基盤を提供する。

title: Transverse Confinement in Cascaded Inverse-Cherenkov Acceleration via Phase-Trajectory Control and Injection Matching
abstract: Sub-relativistic electrons in micron-scale dielectric laser accelerators face coupled challenges of longitudinal dephasing and transverse defocusing, often imposing stringent requirements on injector emittance. Here, we demonstrate a combined strategy of phase-trajectory control and injection matching for sustained, confined acceleration. By coordinating the refractive-index and section-length sequences with the injected beam's Twiss parameters, we control accumulated phase slippage while maintaining transverse confinement. In a seven-section inverse-Cherenkov accelerator simulation, a 100-keV electron bunch with an initial normalized transverse emittance of 1 nm-rad and a relative kinetic-energy spread of 0.1% reaches 1154.7 keV over 1.545 mm, with a transverse rms beam size below 1 $\mu$m throughout the accelerating channels. The exit normalized emittance is 1.92 nm-rad, and the relative RMS kinetic-energy spread is 0.6%, with no particle loss under the specified tracking-acceptance criterion. The results demonstrate that coordinated structural sequencing and injection matching can relax injector-emittance requirements by up to approximately two orders of magnitude, offering a route toward compact dielectric accelerators for ultrafast electron diffraction, microscopy, and chip-scale coherent radiation.

summaries.en: By coordinating refractive-index and section-length sequences with the injected beam's Twiss parameters, a seven-section inverse-Cherenkov accelerator simulation accelerates a 100-keV bunch to 1154.
summaries.zh: 通过将折射率和段长序列与注入束的Twiss参数相协调，七段逆切伦科夫加速器模拟将100 keV电子束在1.
summaries.ja: 屈折率とセクション長の系列を入射ビームのTwissパラメータと協調させることで、7セクションの逆チェレンコフ加速器シミュレーションでは100 keVの電子バンチを1.

title: Switching off a high-harmonic polarization channel by anti-unitary symmetry
abstract: We study polarization-resolved high-harmonic generation in a laser-driven two-leg Su--Schrieffer--Heeger ladder with asymmetric dimerization under periodic boundary conditions. A field linearly polarized along the ladder can generate both longitudinal and transverse radiation, whose harmonic content is controlled by lattice symmetry and electronic filling. Using symmetry analysis of the time-dependent density matrix, we show that reflection symmetry enforces odd-order harmonics in the longitudinal response and, when the transverse response is nonzero, even-order harmonics in the transverse direction. At half filling, an additional anti-unitary symmetry relating the occupied and empty bands suppresses the transverse current completely. A unitary chiral symmetry in the clean ladder relates the same bands but fails to enforce this cancellation, showing that band swapping alone is insufficient: the suppression requires both a density-matrix constraint that persists during the driven evolution and the appropriate transformation of the transverse-current operator. Moving away from half filling lifts this cancellation and allows transverse emission, while the reflection selection rule remains whenever reflection symmetry is preserved. Numerical calculations at quarter and half filling, combined with onsite potentials that selectively break the relevant symmetries, confirm these two distinct mechanisms. Thus, reflection symmetry determines which harmonic orders occur, whereas the interplay of anti-unitary symmetry and filling controls whether the transverse HHG channel is present at all.

summaries.en: In a laser-driven two-leg Su-Schrieffer-Heeger ladder, reflection symmetry dictates which harmonic orders appear, while an anti-unitary symmetry at half filling suppresses the transverse high-harmonic channel entirely, a cancellation not achieved by the unitary chiral symmetry alone.
summaries.zh: 在激光驱动的双腿Su-Schrieffer-Heeger梯形晶格中，反射对称性决定出现哪些谐波阶次，而半填充下的反幺正对称性会完全抑制横向高次谐波通道，这种抵消无法仅靠幺正手征对称性实现。
summaries.ja: レーザー駆動された二本脚Su-Schrieffer-Heegerはしごにおいて、反射対称性はどの高調波次数が現れるかを決め、半充填時の反ユニタリ対称性は横方向高調波チャネルを完全に抑制し、この打消しはユニタリなカイラル対称性だけでは達成されない。

title: Laboratory study of mineral dust optical properties extending in the far-infrared spectral range
abstract: Mineral dust is one of the most abundant atmospheric aerosol types and remains a major source of uncertainty in estimates of aerosol radiative forcing. This uncertainty is particularly important in the far-infrared (FIR) spectral region, where the optical properties of natural mineral dust, especially its complex refractive index (CRI), remain poorly known. Previous measurements have commonly relied on pellet- or film-based methods, which can alter particle size, shape, and vibrational modes, inducing errors in the CRI determination. In this study, we present a laboratory investigation on six natural mineral dust samples with contrasting compositions and originated from major dust source regions worldwide, including Arizona, Atacama, China, Niger, Saudi Arabia, and Tunisia. Suspended dust aerosols were generated under controlled dry conditions and characterized using extinction spectroscopy from the infrared 250 to 4000 cm^-1 (2.5 to 40 micrometers) to the Ultraviolet-Visible (UV-Vis) from 10000 to 40000 cm^-1 (0.25 to 1 micrometer) spectral range, combined with particle size distribution measurements. The real and imaginary parts of the CRI were retrieved for all six samples, revealing a significant absorption and pronounced spectral variability in the FIR. These variations should be accounted for in remote sensing and dust radiative effect studies.

summaries.en: Suspended aerosols from six natural mineral dust samples collected in Arizona, Atacama, China, Niger, Saudi Arabia, and Tunisia were characterized by extinction spectroscopy from 250 to 4000 cm^-1 in the far-infrared and 10000 to 40000 cm^-1 in the UV-Vis together with particle size distributions, yielding retrieved real and imaginary parts of the complex refractive index that reveal significant absorption and pronounced spectral variability in the far-infrared.
summaries.zh: 本研究在受控干燥条件下生成来自亚利桑那、阿塔卡马、中国、尼日尔、沙特阿拉伯和突尼斯六个自然矿物沙尘样品的悬浮气溶胶，结合粒径分布测量，利用远红外250至4000 cm^-1及紫外-可见10000至40000 cm^-1波段的消光光谱进行表征，反演得到六个样品的复折射率实部和虚部，揭示出远红外波段显著的吸收和明显的光谱变化。
summaries.ja: アリゾナ、アタカマ、中国、ニジェール、サウジアラビア、チュニジア由来の6つの天然鉱物ダスト試料について、乾燥管理条件下で浮遊エアロゾルを生成し、粒径分布測定とともに遠赤外250〜4000 cm^-1および紫外可視10000〜40000 cm^-1の消散分光で特性評価を行い、6試料すべての複素屈折率の実部と虚部を導出した結果、遠赤外域で顕著な吸収と著しいスペクトル変動が明らかになった。

title: Focusing through coupled multimode fibers for miniaturized single-atom tweezer arrays
abstract: Real-world deployment of quantum technologies requires systems in low SWaP-C packages. Quantum platforms based on ultracold atoms typically trap and control atoms with optical tweezers using light focused through bulky objective lenses, which are costly and sensitive to misalignment. Multimode fibers (MMFs) offer a compact route to focusing light, but their use in forming optical tweezers for cold atoms has been limited to a single fiber. Here we use a 2x1 MMF fused coupler to obtain two independent control paths sharing a common distal facet. We form near-diffraction-limited tweezers through each channel, suppress interference by applying a small frequency offset between the channels, and demonstrate that the tweezer separation is insensitive to misalignment of the input coupling. This work provides a route to reconfigurable single-atom arrays in low SWaP-C environments.

summaries.en: Using a 2x1 multimode fiber fused coupler with a shared distal facet, the authors form near-diffraction-limited optical tweezers through two independent channels, suppress inter-channel interference with a small frequency offset, and show that the tweezer separation is insensitive to input-coupling misalignment, enabling reconfigurable single-atom arrays in low SWaP-C settings.
summaries.zh: 作者利用具有共享远端面的2×1多模光纤熔融耦合器，通过两个独立通道形成接近衍射极限的光镊，并施加小频率偏移抑制通道间干涉，同时证明光镊间距对输入耦合失准不敏感，为低SWaP-C环境下的可重构单原子阵列提供了途径。
summaries.ja: 著者らは、共通の遠端面を持つ2×1マルチモードファイバ融着カプラーを用いて2つの独立チャネルから回折限界に近い光ピンセットを形成し、チャネル間に小さな周波数オフセットを加えて干渉を抑制するとともに、ピンセット間隔が入力結合の位置ずれに鈍感であることを示し、低SWaP-C環境での再構成可能な単一原子アレイへの道を開いた。

title: Second-order Bethe-Salpeter kernels: the interplay of vertex-corrected quasiparticle energies and the screened interaction
abstract: We study second-order Bethe-Salpeter kernels generated by truncating an iterative formulation of Hedin's equations after the second cycle. Starting from the Hartree-Fock or the $GW$ self-energy, whose first cycles correspond to TDHF and $GW$+BSE, we obtain the second-cycle kernel by differentiating the first-cycle correlation self-energy with the interacting correlation function replaced by the non-interacting one, and evaluate it in the static limit of the effective kernel. Using fixed restricted Hartree-Fock orbitals, we benchmark 30 singlet and 28 triplet excitation energies for seven small molecules (six for the triplets) against the theoretical best estimates from QUEST v1.2. The second cycle lowers the mean absolute error (MAE) in both sequences. For the $GW$ sequence, the MAE decreases from 0.63 to 0.29 eV (singlets), on par with ADC(2) (0.30 eV), and from 0.43 to 0.38 eV (triplets). BSE$^{(2)}$@HF removes the triplet instabilities of TDHF and yields MAEs of 0.43 and 0.38 eV, or 0.31 and 0.30 eV when the Tamm-Dancoff approximation is applied in all cycles. Assigning the statically screened interaction $W_0$ to the exchange part of the $GW$ self-energy counts second-order screening twice in the second-cycle kernel and strongly blueshifts valence excitations. Without this double counting, dressing the exchange-type terms with $W_0$ lowers the singlet MAE from 0.37 to 0.29 eV but leaves the triplets nearly unchanged. Replacing second-order Green's function (GF2) quasiparticle energies by vertex-corrected ones in the same kernel raises excitation energies by about 0.7 eV, improving Rydberg but degrading valence excitations. A perturbative dynamical correction of the kernel blueshifts valence excitations by 0.3-0.4 eV and increases the errors of all full-matrix BSE$^{(2)}$ variants. The consistent improvement over the first cycle suggests that higher cycles are worth pursuing.

summaries.en: Second-order Bethe-Salpeter kernels obtained by truncating Hedin's equations after the second cycle lower excitation-energy errors relative to first-cycle TDHF and GW+BSE benchmarks, though double-counting screened exchange and using vertex-corrected quasiparticle energies introduce significant shifts and degrade valence excitations.
summaries.zh: 通过在第二次循环后截断Hedin方程得到的二阶Bethe-Salpeter核相比第一循环的TDHF和GW+BSE基准降低了激发能误差，但交换项中屏蔽相互作用的重复计入以及使用顶点修正的准粒子能量会引入显著位移并降低价激发的精度。
summaries.ja: Hedin方程式を第2サイクルで打ち切ることで得られる2次Bethe-Salpeterカーネルは、第1サイクルのTDHFおよびGW+BSEのベンチマークと比べて励起エネルギー誤差を低減するが、遮蔽交換項の二重計上や頂点補正準粒子エネルギーの使用は大きなシフトを生じ、価電子励起の精度を低下させる。

title: Soft X-Ray Detection Down to the Nitrogen K-Edge Using a Pixelated iLGAD Sensor
abstract: Hybrid pixel detectors represent the state-of-the-art technology for hard X-ray experiments at synchrotron light sources and free-electron lasers, owing to their high frame rates, extended dynamic range, and scalable detection areas. However, their application in the soft X-ray regime remains bottlenecked by the challenge of developing a sensor that can achieve high quantum efficiency and an sufficient signal-to-noise ratio at low photon energies. Here, we present inverse low-gain avalanche diode (iLGAD) sensors integrated with a thin entrance window, demonstrating single-photon resolution down to 390 eV (below the Nitrogen K-edge) with a signal-to-noise ratio of 5. Two gain layer designs, standard gain layer and shallow gain layer, were systematically investigated to evaluate their spectral response as a function of photon energy and operating temperature. A double-peak feature is observed in the energy spectrum, arising from the dependence of charge multiplication on photon absorption depth. Furthermore, a phenomenological spectral fitting model was established, enabling the quantitative extraction of the effective $\mathrm{n}^+$ layer thickness and gain layer depth. Beyond providing a fundamental understanding of iLGAD charge multiplication mechanisms and characterization results in the soft X-ray regime, these findings lay the foundation for developing large-area, high-frame-rate hybrid pixel detectors for soft X-ray. This advancement directly benefits soft X-ray photon science applications, including high-resolution ptychography, spectroscopy, and resonant scattering at synchrotron and FEL beamlines.

summaries.en: Researchers demonstrated that hybrid pixel detectors using pixelated inverse low-gain avalanche diode (iLGAD) sensors with a thin entrance window achieve single-photon resolution down to 390 eV, below the nitrogen K-edge, with a signal-to-noise ratio of 5, and they developed a phenomenological spectral fitting model to quantify charge multiplication effects.
summaries.zh: 研究人员证明，采用带薄入射窗的像素化反型低增益雪崩二极管（iLGAD）传感器的混合像素探测器可在低至390 eV（低于氮K边）实现单光子分辨，信噪比为5，并建立了唯象光谱拟合模型以定量提取电荷倍增效应。
summaries.ja: 研究者らは、薄い入射窓を備えたピクセル化逆低利得アバランシェダイオード（iLGAD）センサーを用いたハイブリッドピクセル検出器が、窒素K端以下の390 eVまで単一光子分解能を信号対雑音比5で達成することを示し、電荷増倍効果を定量化する現象論的光譜フィッティングモデルを構築した。

title: Field-resolved observation and quantification of the instantaneous Kerr response in semiconductors
abstract: The optical Kerr effect, whereby the refractive index of a material changes with light intensity, underpins nonlinear photonics and emerging mid-infrared technologies. Accurate determination of the nonlinear refractive index is therefore essential, yet conventional intensity-based techniques infer the nonlinear phase shift indirectly from changes in beam propagation or optical spectra. Moreover, methods such as the $z$-scan cannot resolve the temporal evolution of the nonlinear response, making it difficult to distinguish instantaneous Kerr nonlinearities from delayed contributions, including free-carrier effects. Here, we investigate the nonlinear optical response of germanium at $5 \mu\mathrm{m}$ using field-resolved degenerate pump-probe spectroscopy. By measuring the transmitted probe electric field as a function of pump-probe delay, we directly retrieve the pump-induced phase shift and its temporal evolution while retaining sensitivity to changes in absorption. We observe cross-phase modulation that follows the pump intensity envelope and vanishes when the pump and probe no longer overlap, consistent with an instantaneous Kerr response. The phase shift scales linearly with pump intensity, yielding a nonlinear refractive index of $n_2=(0.87\pm0.16)\times10^{-17} \mathrm{m}^2/\mathrm{W}$. Our results establish the instantaneous Kerr effect as the dominant contribution to the measured nonlinear phase shift under our experimental conditions and demonstrate field-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy as a direct, time-resolved method for determining the nonlinear refractive index and distinguishing instantaneous from delayed optical responses.

summaries.en: Using field-resolved degenerate pump-probe spectroscopy at 5 μm, the authors directly retrieve the pump-induced phase shift in germanium, observe cross-phase modulation consistent with an instantaneous Kerr response that scales linearly with pump intensity, and determine a nonlinear refractive index of n2=(0.
summaries.zh: 作者利用5微米波段的场分辨简并泵浦-探测光谱直接提取了锗中泵浦诱导的相移，观察到与瞬时克尔响应一致的交叉相位调制，该相移随泵浦强度线性变化，并测得非线性折射率为n2=(0.
summaries.ja: 著者らは5μmの電場分解縮退ポンプ・プローブ分光法によりゲルマニウム中のポンプ誘起位相シフトを直接取得し、ポンプ強度に線形に比例する即時カー応答と一致する相互位相変調を観測して、非線形屈折率n2=(0.

title: Fock-space delocalization and its control in scarred-vs-ergodic dynamics
abstract: Quantum many-body scarred dynamics in Rydberg-atom arrays is characterized by revivals, in which the system repeatedly returns to its initial state despite its many-body complexity. But how extensively does the wave function explore the space of allowed configurations between revivals? We address this question by quantifying the fraction of configurations occupied during PXP dynamics initialized from the paradigmatic polarized and Néel states, which respectively exhibit thermalizing and scarred dynamics. Despite their striking revivals, dynamics from the Néel state spreads over exponentially many configurations, yet occupies a vanishing fraction of the full space in the thermodynamic limit. Dynamics from the polarized state, by contrast, occupies a finite fraction of the configuration space, close to anticoncentration and random-state statistics, although chiral symmetry limits this fraction to one third. A weak quasiperiodic field enables the polarized state to occupy half of the configuration space by lifting the constraint imposed by chiral symmetry. The Néel state, however, requires a stronger field to reach a comparable anticoncentrated regime. As the field increases further, the occupied fraction decreases for both initial states, revealing a nonmonotonic dependence of Fock-space delocalization on field strength without necessarily implying localization.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech)

summaries.en: In PXP dynamics of Rydberg-atom arrays, the Néel state exhibits scarred revivals while spreading over exponentially many configurations but occupying a vanishing fraction of Fock space in the thermodynamic limit, whereas the polarized state occupies a finite fraction near anticoncentration limited to one third by chiral symmetry, and a weak quasiperiodic field lifts this constraint to allow half the space for the polarized state, with both states showing nonmonotonic field dependence of delocalization.
summaries.zh: 在里德堡原子阵列的PXP动力学中，奈尔态虽表现出疤痕式复苏并扩展到指数多个构型，但在热力学极限下仅占据相空间的一小部分，而极化态占据接近反浓缩的有限比例且受手征对称性限制为三分之一，弱准周期场可解除该限制使极化态占据一半构型空间，且两种初态的去局域化随场强呈非单调变化。
summaries.ja: リドバーグ原子配列のPXP力学において、ネール状態は scarring 的な復活を示しつつ指数関数的に多くの配置に広がるが熱力学極限ではフォック空間のごく一部しか占めない一方、偏極状態はカイラル対称性により3分の1に制限された反集中に近い有限割合を占め、弱い準周期場がこの制約を解除して偏極状態が配置空間の半分を占めることを可能にし、両初期状態とも非局在化の場依存性は非単調となる。

title: Optical Quantum Memory Processing for Quantum Hashing
