abstract: Sender authentication is an important requirement for secure quantum communication networks. We propose programmable photon-echo quantum memory processing of a multi-time-bin photonic qudit for implementing a quantum-hash-based verification protocol. In this approach, using QM, sender (Alice) generates a quantum hash state by transforming a single stored photonic wave packet into the programmable photonic qudit. Bob's memory coherently maps the received time-bin photonic qudit into a single output mode according to phase encoding. Our scheme relies on a time-resolved coherent detection method introduced here, in which the coherent responses from individual time-bins are sequentially accumulated within Bob's spin coherence prior to the final sender verification. The key advantage of this coherent detection for quantum hashing is shown, and its potential applications are also discussed. The performed analysis demonstrates that experimentally verified parameters of contemporary optical quantum memories enable a proof of principle realization of the proposed architecture. These results reveal an additional role for quantum memories, serving not only as synchronization and repeater resources for long-distance quantum communication, but also as active elements for quantum hashing in conventional quantum key distribution systems.

summaries.en: This paper proposes programmable photon-echo quantum memory processing of a multi-time-bin photonic qudit to implement a quantum-hash-based sender authentication protocol, using a time-resolved coherent detection method in which coherent responses from individual time-bins accumulate in Bob's spin coherence, and shows that experimentally verified parameters of current optical quantum memories enable proof-of-principle realization.
summaries.zh: 本文提出利用可编程光子回波量子存储器处理多时间bin光子qudit，以实现基于量子哈希的发送方认证协议，并采用时间分辨相干检测方法使各时间bin的相干响应在Bob的自旋相干中累积，分析表明现有光量子存储器的实验参数即可支持该架构的原理验证实现。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、多時間ビンのフォトニックquditに対するプログラマブルな光子エコー量子メモリ処理を用いて量子ハッシュに基づく送信者認証プロトコルを実装することを提案し、各時間ビンのコヒーレント応答をBobのスピンコヒーレンス内で順次蓄積する時間分解コヒーレント検出法を導入するとともに、現行の光量子メモリの実験的に検証されたパラメータで原理実証が可能であることを示す。

title: Vacuum amplification across a programmable bosonic Bogoliubov stability boundary in a trapped-ion chain
abstract: A quantum oscillator always carries vacuum fluctuations, and modulating its parameters converts them into correlated pairs of real quanta. This vacuum amplification underlies squeezed light and Hawking radiation. In a closed quadratic system, pair creation competes with the energy splitting of the modes, and growth turns exponential only once pairing overcomes the splitting. Here we realize this competition in two motional modes of a trapped-ion chain. A two-mode-squeezing drive creates the pairs, and a beam-splitter coupling splits the motion into two coupled modes at different frequencies. The two rates are tuned and calibrated independently. Starting near the motional ground state, we cross the stability boundary in two ways. First, with the drive at the sum of the two bare-mode frequencies, the phonon number stays bounded until the pairing rate exceeds the splitting and grows exponentially beyond it. Second, tuning the drive into resonance with one coupled mode lowers the threshold to zero, and only that mode is amplified into a squeezed vacuum. Separate control of the two interactions makes the threshold for vacuum amplification programmable. This control can be used to simulate particle creation and quantum phase transitions, and to operate parametrically driven bosonic devices close to their stability limit.

summaries.en: By independently tuning a two-mode-squeezing drive and a beam-splitter coupling between two motional modes of a trapped-ion chain, the experiment crosses a bosonic Bogoliubov stability boundary, showing bounded phonon number until pairing overcomes mode splitting and exponential growth beyond it, with the threshold lowered to zero and a squeezed vacuum amplified in a single mode when the drive is resonant with one coupled mode.
summaries.zh: 通过在囚禁离子链的两个运动模式间独立调节双模压缩驱动与分束器耦合，该实验跨越了玻色型Bogoliubov稳定性边界，证明在配对速率超过模式劈裂前声子数保持有界、超过后呈指数增长，并且当驱动与某一耦合模式共振时阈值降为零、仅该模式被放大为压缩真空。
summaries.ja: トラップされたイオン鎖の2つの運動モード間で2モードスクイーズ駆動とビームスプリッター結合を独立に調整することにより、この実験はボソニックBogoliubov安定性境界を越え、ペア生成率がモード分裂を上回るまではフォノン数が有界に保たれ、超えると指数関数的に増大すること、また駆動を一方の結合モードに共鳴させると閾値がゼロになりそのモードのみがスクイーズド真空へ増幅されることを示した。

title: Anomalous superradiant phases in a quantum Rabi zigzag chain under a synthetic gauge field
abstract: We present the phase diagram of a one-dimensional quantum Rabi zigzag chain under an artificial gauge field, which is implemented via phase-modulated next-nearest-neighbor (NNN) hopping. For a system size of $N=8$, we analytically determine the order parameters and critical thresholds, identifying five distinct superradiant phases. For strong nearest-neighbor (NN) coupling, the system exhibits either a ferro-superradiant (FSR) or an antiferro-superradiant (AFSR) phase depending on its sign. Increasing NNN coupling induces a stripe antiferro-superradiant (sAFSR) phase with antiparallel NNN and parallel NN displacements, which is distinct from the conventional AFSR phase. Tuning the magnetic flux drives the system into chiral or antichiral superradiant phases with opposite ground-state photon currents, which are different from the conventional superradiant phases. Remarkably, geometric frustration within each triangular plaquette stabilizes chiral phases even at small magnetic flux while suppressing the sAFSR phase, which vanishes for $N=6$. Mapping the system onto an effective magnetic Hamiltonian yields an analogous phase diagram featuring distinct magnetic phases, offering insight into the anomalous superradiant phases. This equivalence establishes a quantum optical platform for simulating chiral magnetism.

summaries.en: The paper analytically maps the phase diagram of an N=8 one-dimensional quantum Rabi zigzag chain with phase-modulated next-nearest-neighbor hopping and an artificial gauge field, identifying five distinct superradiant phases—including ferro-, antiferro-, stripe-antiferro-, chiral and antichiral superradiant phases—whose stability is governed by geometric frustration of triangular plaquettes and which correspond to magnetic phases of an effective spin Hamiltonian.
summaries.zh: 本文解析给出了N=8的一维量子Rabi锯齿链在相位调制的次近邻跃迁所构成的人工规范场下的相图，识别出铁超辐射、反铁超辐射、条纹反铁超辐射、手性超辐射和反手性超辐射五种不同的超辐射相，其中三角 plaquette 的几何阻挫在小磁通下稳定手性相并抑制条纹反铁超辐射相，且系统可映射为具有相应磁相的有效磁性哈密顿量。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、位相変調された次近接ホッピングによる人工ゲージ場を備えたN=8の一次元量子Rabiジグザグ鎖の相図を解析的に求め、強磁性超放射相・反強磁性超放射相・ストライプ反強磁性超放射相・カイラル超放射相・反カイラル超放射相の五つの超放射相を同定し、三角プラケットの幾何学的フラストレーションが小磁束でもカイラル相を安定化してストライプ反強磁性相を抑制すること、および有効磁気ハミルトニアンへの写像が対応する磁気相を与えることを示した。

title: Parametric Enhancement of an Optical Spring in a Dark Signal-Recycling Cavity
abstract: Optical springs tailor the response of precision sensors. Parametric amplification of the signal field stiffens the spring, extending the precision to higher frequencies. A Michelson interferometer operated at a dark fringe is the most direct way to separate the signal from the carrier for amplification. We experimentally demonstrate such quantum manipulation of the optical spring by placing an optical parametric amplifier in a cavity at the dark port, showing a significant increase of the optical-spring constant with the parametric gain within a factor of four below the oscillation threshold.

summaries.en: By placing an optical parametric amplifier at the dark port of a dark-fringe Michelson interferometer, the optical-spring constant is significantly increased with parametric gain up to a factor of four below the oscillation threshold, demonstrating quantum manipulation of an optical spring.
summaries.zh: 通过在暗条纹迈克耳孙干涉仪的暗端口放置光学参量放大器，光学弹簧常数随参量增益显著增大，在振荡阈值以下四倍范围内实现了对光学弹簧的量子操控。
summaries.ja: 暗縞マイケルソン干渉計のダークポートに光パラメトリック増幅器を配置することで、発振しきい値の4倍以内の範囲でパラメトリック利得に伴い光学ばね定数が顕著に増大し、光学ばねの量子操作を実証した。

title: Time-Domain Multiplexing for Resource-Efficient Heralded GKP State Preparation
abstract: Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) states are key resources for fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing, but their conditional preparation via Gaussian boson sampling involves a trade-off between source count and photon-number resolution. Distributing heralding photons across more measured modes reduces the resolution required per mode, yet increases the number of simultaneously operated squeezed sources in fully squeezed spatial architectures. Here, we show that time-domain multiplexing (TDM) can reduce these physical source requirements while preserving GKP state quality. Using an end-to-end differentiable Bargmann framework, we find that TDM circuits reusing one or two squeezed sources achieve fidelities comparable to fully squeezed spatial circuits across several configurations. Selected nine-mode configurations retain fidelities above 0.95 with one photon heralded in each measured mode, mitigating detector resolution demands without a proportional increase in source count. Loss-aware reoptimization further shows that, under the investigated spatial loss models, two-mode TDM maintains fidelities near 0.80 at 1.0 dB per channel, whereas the corresponding spatial benchmarks fall below 0.60. These results demonstrate that temporal reuse provides an effective architectural route for balancing source overhead, detection demands, and state preparation performance in the presence of optical loss.

summaries.en: Using an end-to-end differentiable Bargmann framework, this study shows that time-domain multiplexing circuits reusing one or two squeezed sources can prepare heralded GKP states with fidelities comparable to fully squeezed spatial circuits, retaining fidelities above 0.
summaries.zh: 该研究采用端到端可微分的Bargmann框架表明，复用一到两个压缩源的时间域复用电路所制备的预示GKP态保真度可与全压缩空间电路相当，在部分九模配置中保真度保持在0.
summaries.ja: 本研究は、エンドツーエンドで微分可能なBargmannフレームワークを用いて、1つまたは2つのスクイーズド光源を再利用する時間領域多重化回路が、全スクイーズド空間回路に匹敵する忠実度でヘラルデッドGKP状態を生成でき、選択した9モード構成では0.

title: High-efficiency photonic GHZ measurements with linear optics
abstract: Probabilistic and destructive Bell-measurements, also known as fusions, constitute a fundamental primitive for photonic quantum technologies. These operations rely only on pairwise photonic interference, whereas the computational power of photonic quantum systems originates from many-body interference. Here, we introduce a family of high-efficiency linear-optical GHZ measurements based on four-mode interferometers and show that incorporating many-body interference into this ubiquitous primitive leads to more efficient entangling operations. For the four-photon case, the success probability is $9/32$, and adaptive variants ensure that unsuccessful events project onto useful stabilizer states. We further show that the approach naturally generalizes to larger GHZ measurements, yielding an exponentially higher success probability than previous linear-optical schemes. Finally, we demonstrate practical advantages for graph-state resource generation, entanglement distribution between remote spin-photon interfaces, and fusion-based quantum computing. Our results establish high-efficiency many-body measurements as a new primitive for scalable photonic quantum information processing.

summaries.en: The paper introduces high-efficiency linear-optical GHZ measurements based on four-mode interferometers that exploit many-body interference, achieving a four-photon success probability of 9/32 and an exponentially higher success probability than previous linear-optical schemes for larger GHZ measurements, with practical advantages for graph-state resource generation, entanglement distribution between remote spin-photon interfaces, and fusion-based quantum computing.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了基于四模干涉仪的高效线性光学GHZ测量方法，利用多体干涉，在四光子情形下成功概率达到9/32，并且对于更大的GHZ测量，其成功概率比以往线性光学方案呈指数级提高，同时在图态资源生成、远程自旋-光子接口间的纠缠分发以及基于聚变的量子计算中展现了实际优势。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、四モード干渉計に基づく高効率な線形光学GHZ測定を提案し、多体干渉を利用することで4光子の場合に成功確率9/32を達成するとともに、より大きなGHZ測定では従来の線形光学手法より指数的に高い成功確率を実現し、グラフ状態リソース生成、遠隔スピン-光子インターフェース間のエンタングルメント配布、フュージョン型量子計算における実用的優位性を示した。

title: A Highly Nondegenerate Photon-Pair Source for Detector-Matched Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: In a commercial entanglement-distribution system over telecom fibre, the single-photon detectors are the largest part of the hardware cost. In entanglement-based quantum key distribution (QKD), both photons of each pair must be detected. With two telecom photons, each arm needs either an InGaAs single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) of low efficiency or a superconducting nanowire single-photon detector (SNSPD) with its own cryostat. We study a highly nondegenerate photon-pair source that needs a telecom detector on one arm only. Two periodically poled KTiOPO$_4$ (ppKTP) crystals pumped at 405~nm emit pairs at 548 and 1550~nm. A Si-SPAD with 82\% efficiency detects the 548~nm photon at the source node, and only the 1550~nm photon travels through fibre. A first, unoptimised module in a polarisation-correlated configuration generates about $1.5\times10^6$ pairs/s per mW of pump power. It collects 13\% of the pairs on the 548~nm arm and 23\% on the 1550~nm arm. In an asymptotic BBM92 model, we compare its links with generic $2\times1550$~nm links that use a bright published source at the same pump power. At 50~km, our link with one SNSPD costs about 25\% more per secret bit than the generic link with one SNSPD. With optimistic target values of 52\% collection and twice the brightness, it costs about 40\% as much as the generic link with two SNSPDs. Our link without a cryostat then costs about 70\% less than the generic link with one SNSPD. If every link runs at its own best pump power, the two-SNSPD link is again the cheapest. The source can also serve clock synchronisation and detector calibration, which need only time-correlated pairs. All key rates assume the entangled configuration of the source, which is under development.

summaries.en: A highly nondegenerate ppKTP source emitting 548 nm and 1550 nm photon pairs, with the 548 nm photon detected by an 82%-efficiency Si-SPAD at the source node while only the 1550 nm photon traverses the fibre, is evaluated in an asymptotic BBM92 model for detector-matched QKD and could reduce hardware cost compared with generic 2×1550 nm links, though the two-SNSPD generic link remains cheapest when every link runs at its own best pump power and the entangled configuration is still under development.
summaries.zh: 本文研究了一种高度非简并的ppKTP光子对源，其在405 nm泵浦下产生548 nm和1550 nm光子对，548 nm光子由源节点处效率为82%的硅单光子雪崩二极管探测，仅1550 nm光子经光纤传输，并在渐近BBM92模型中评估其用于探测器匹配量子密钥分发可降低硬件成本，但若各链路均以自身最佳泵浦功率运行，通用双SNSPD链路仍最便宜，且该源的纠缠配置仍在研发中。
summaries.ja: 405 nm励起のppKTP結晶から548 nmと1550 nmの光子対を生成し、548 nm光子を光源ノードの効率82%のSi-SPADで検出して1550 nm光子のみをファイバー伝送する highly nondegenerate 光源を漸近BBM92モデルで評価したところ、検出器整合型QKDのハードウェアコスト削減が期待できるが、各リンクが自身の最適ポンプパワーで動作する場合は汎用2×1550 nmリンク（SNSPD 2台）が依然として最も安価であり、光源のエンタングル配置は開発中である。

title: Benchmarking Single-Photon Sources for Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution (MDI-QKD) enables secure communication without trusting the measurement devices, but its performance critically depends on the quality of the employed photon sources. We compare MDI-QKD implementations based on Weak Coherent Pulses (WCPs) with those employing Quantum Dot (QD) single-photon sources. WCP-based schemes are fundamentally limited by Poissonian photon-number statistics, imposing a trade-off between single- and multi-photon emissions, whereas QD sources exhibit sub-Poissonian statistics with low antibunching parameter $g^{(2)}(0)$. Using a decoy-state analysis for both source types, we find that even at moderate mean photon numbers, QD-based implementations outperform the best-case WCP configuration - where the mean photon number is optimised at each transmission distance - across the full range of transmission distances. We further incorporate the effect of imperfect photon indistinguishability via Hong-Ou-Mandel interference visibilities into the security framework and demonstrate that both source types are highly sensitive to even small deviations from ideal indistinguishability, significantly affecting achievable key rates and maximum transmission distance.

summaries.en: This paper benchmarks measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution using quantum dot single-photon sources against weak coherent pulse sources, finding that quantum dot sources outperform the best-case optimized weak coherent pulse configurations at all transmission distances and that both source types are highly sensitive to imperfect photon indistinguishability.
summaries.zh: 本文评估了基于量子点单光子源的测量设备无关量子密钥分发与弱相干脉冲方案的性能，发现量子点源在所有传输距离上均优于经过最优化的弱相干脉冲最佳配置，并且两种源类型对不完美光子不可区分性都高度敏感。
summaries.ja: 本論文は量子ドット単一光子源を用いた測定デバイス非依存量子鍵配送を弱コヒーレントパルス方式と比較評価し、量子ドット源が全伝送距離で最適化された弱コヒーレントパルスの最良構成を上回ること、および両方式が不完全な光子の識別不可能性に非常に敏感であることを示した。

title: Pinching Antennas for ISAC: Waveguide Architectures, Solutions, and Future Directions
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a core design principle for sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems, yet fixed antenna geometry limits its performance. Pinching antenna systems (PASS) guide electromagnetic waves along dielectric waveguides and radiate them through position-adaptive antennas, allowing communication links and sensing observations to benefit from spatial reconfiguration. This article reviews PASS-enabled ISAC through single-waveguide, multi-waveguide, and segmented-waveguide architectures, comparing their feed structures, spatial degrees of freedom, operating protocols, and uplink/downlink support. We organize solution pathways around physics-consistent modeling, joint spatial-signal optimization, dynamic channel acquisition, and stable real-time control. A segmented waveguide-enabled pinching-antenna array (SWAN) case study demonstrates joint segment selection, antenna po?sitioning, and transmit beamforming using segment-hysteresis reinforcement learning. The results illustrate how waveguide loss and per-segment aperture gain create communication-sensing tradeoffs. We conclude with research directions in joint transmit?receive operation, measurement-calibrated digital twins, and trustworthy control.

summaries.en: This article reviews pinching antenna systems (PASS) for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), comparing single-, multi-, and segmented-waveguide architectures and organizing solution pathways around physics-consistent modeling, joint spatial-signal optimization, dynamic channel acquisition, and stable real-time control, with a segmented waveguide-enabled pinching-antenna array (SWAN) case study using segment-hysteresis reinforcement learning to show communication-sensing tradeoffs arising from waveguide loss and per-segment aperture gain.
summaries.zh: 本文综述了面向通感一体化（ISAC）的引脚天线系统（PASS），比较了单波导、多波导和分段波导架构，并围绕物理一致性建模、联合空间-信号优化、动态信道获取和稳定实时控制组织解决路径，同时以基于分段波导的引脚天线阵列（SWAN）为例，利用分段迟滞强化学习展示由波导损耗和分段孔径增益引起的通信-感知权衡。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、統合センシング・通信（ISAC）のためのピンチングアンテナシステム（PASS）をレビューし、単一波導・多重波導・セグメント化波導の各アーキテクチャを比較するとともに、物理整合モデリング、空間-信号同時最適化、動的チャネル取得、安定したリアルタイム制御を軸に解決手法を整理し、セグメント化波導を用いたピンチングアンテナアレイ（SWAN）の事例でセグメントヒステリシス強化学習により波導損失とセグメントごとの開口利得に起因する通信-センシングのトレードオフを示す。

title: Channel Measurement and Characteristics Analysis for Indoor Flexible Pinching Antenna Systems in the mmWave Band
abstract: Pinching antenna (PA) systems offer flexible antenna configurations for future wireless communications, yet how PA geometry, orientation, and position affect channel characteristics in practical environments remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, this paper first presents an indoor PA system channel measurement campaign at 59.5~GHz. A dedicated time-domain channel sounder is developed with frequency conversion and a circular-waveguide-to-dielectric-waveguide transition to feed the radio frequency (RF) signal into a flexible dielectric waveguide. Using this platform, office measurements quantify channel attenuation and channel characteristics by examining four PA geometries, arc PA orientation, circle PA pinching position, and transmitter--receiver height difference. The channel measurement data are analyzed in terms of path loss, shadow fading, root-mean-square (RMS) delay spread, Rician K-factor, normalized capacity, and spatial similarity. Indoor path loss models for PA systems are fitted for each PA geometry. The results reveal geometry-dependent attenuation and shadow-fading variability, with the arc PA showing greater variability than the circle PA. Arc PA rotation shifts the delay spread and conditional K-factor distributions. Moving the circle PA produces nonmonotonic changes in delay spread and normalized capacity, while spatial similarity remains relatively high at many receiver locations as the pinching position changes. These observations provide an empirical basis for PA systems channel model and system design.

title: Dynamic-Aware LC-DMA Beam Tracking for LEO Satellite Communications
abstract: Liquid crystal (LC)-based dynamic metasurface antennas (DMAs) offer a power-efficient, low-cost, and scalable solution for low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite communications where large apertures are needed to compensate for large path loss in the Earth-satellite link. However, beam tracking with LC-DMAs is governed by two coupled dynamics: the required time-varying beam direction caused by user and satellite mobility, and the finite response time of the LC phase shifters. This raises the question of whether LC-DMAs can reconfigure sufficiently fast to support high-mobility LEO satellite links. To address this problem, we develop a dynamic-aware beam-tracking framework that explicitly accounts for both dynamics. In particular, we formulate an optimization problem to maximize the cumulative received signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) over a predictive tracking horizon subject to the physical dynamics of the LC unit cells as well as transmit power constraints. To solve this non-convex problem efficiently, we develop an alternating optimization framework combining a closed-form maximum ratio transmission (MRT) digital precoder and maximum ratio combining (MRC) with a parallel, closed-form dynamic-aware phase-shift update. Simulation results show that when the time response of LC-DMAs is properly accounted for, it can support practical mobility scenarios. Moreover, the proposed dynamic-aware algorithm maintains stable SNR and outperforms conventional designs, particularly at high vehicle velocities and low orbital azimuth angles.

summaries.en: This paper develops a dynamic-aware beam-tracking framework for liquid-crystal dynamic metasurface antennas in LEO satellite communications that jointly accounts for user and satellite mobility and the finite response time of the LC phase shifters by maximizing cumulative received SNR over a predictive horizon via alternating optimization with closed-form MRT/MRC and parallel dynamic-aware phase-shift updates, showing stable SNR and outperformance of conventional designs at high vehicle velocities and low orbital azimuth angles.
summaries.zh: 本文针对低轨卫星通信中的液晶动态超表面天线提出了一种动态感知波束跟踪框架，该框架同时考虑用户与卫星移动引起的波束方向变化以及液晶移相器的有限响应时间，通过在预测跟踪时域内最大化累积接收信噪比并采用结合闭式MRT/MRC与并行闭式动态感知移相更新的交替优化求解，结果表明在正确考虑液晶响应时间时可支持实际移动场景，且在高车速和低轨道方位角下保持稳定信噪比并优于传统设计。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、低軌道衛星通信向けの液晶動的メタサーフェスアンテナにおいて、ユーザーと衛星の移動に起因するビーム方向の時間変化と液晶移相器の有限応答時間の両方を考慮し、予測追跡期間にわたる累積受信SNRを最大化する動的認識ビーム追跡フレームワークを提案し、閉形式MRT/MRCと並列閉形式の動的認識位相更新を組み合わせた交互最適化で解くことで、液晶の応答時間を適切に考慮すれば実用的な移動シナリオを支援でき、特に高速車両や低軌道方位角において安定したSNRを維持し従来設計を上回ることを示した。
